Title: Data Engineer
Description:
¿Qué es Hamelyn?

Somos una empresa tecnológica española que está transformando el mercado de segunda mano. Comprar online es fácil, pero ¿qué pasa con vender lo que ya no necesitas? En Hamelyn, hacemos que vender tus cosas usadas sea rápido y sin complicaciones. Y las revendemos dando un servicio profesional.




Empezamos con libros, y ya hemos añadido música, películas y videojuegos. Y próximamente tendremos nuevas categorías. Ambicionamos ser la aplicación a la que todos acuden para vender sin complicaciones y para comprar productos de segunda mano con el mismo nivel de calidad y servicio que al comprar productos nuevos.




Hoy, Hamelyn atiende a miles de vendedores y compradores diariamente, procesando cientos de miles de productos al mes y enviando pedidos de todas nuestras categorías desde nuestro centro logístico de Madrid a todo el mundo.

Si quieres saber más sobre la historia de Hamelyn, aquí tienes la entrevista de Itnig a nuestros fundadores: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MGkTWW2rVAc&t=10s




Ahora estamos creciendo rápidamente y construyendo una infraestructura de datos a la altura del negocio. Necesitamos un Data Analytics Engineer que trabaje mano a mano con el Data Lead.




🚀¿Listo para construir el futuro con Hamelyn?🚀

Buscamos un experto en datos, perfeccionista con la calidad y la fiabilidad de la información, con experiencia tanto en infraestructura como en análisis de datos. Reportarás al Data Lead.




🎯 Misión:

Mejorar y escalar los sistemas de datos de Hamelyn y analizarlos para impulsar decisiones de negocio y mejoras en producto y tecnología.




🔥 En qué trabajarás:

Operamos en múltiples países con más de 30 millones de productos catalogados e integrados con marketplaces como Amazon, eBay y MercadoLibre. Esto es lo que tenemos por delante:

Analizar datos clave del negocio para detectar patrones, tendencias y oportunidades (pricing, catálogo, conversión, supply, operaciones).
Definir y mantener métricas y fuentes de verdad (dashboards, tablas base, documentación) para que el equipo tome decisiones rápido.
Construir y mejorar pipelines de datos (ETL/ELT) y modelos de datos listos para análisis (data marts), con foco en fiabilidad y rapidez.
Mantener y mejorar bases de datos, data quality y automatizar procesos de reporting.
Apoyar en la construcción y validación de modelos analíticos o predictivos: preparación de datasets, features, validaciones y medición de impacto.
Colaborar con producto y negocio para traducir preguntas en hipótesis, experimentos y decisiones medibles.




Requisitos clave:

Buen dominio de SQL y Python para análisis, automatizaciones y manejo de datos.
Experiencia trabajando con datos en entornos reales: análisis, modelado, pipelines y mantenimiento de fuentes.
Capacidad para convertir datos en decisiones: plantear hipótesis, medir impacto, comunicar hallazgos y proponer acciones.
Bases sólidas en estadística aplicada (tests, segmentación, cohortes, funnels).
Mentalidad hands-on, autonomía y buena comunicación con stakeholders no técnicos.
Experiencia construyendo y/o usando modelos analíticos o predictivos (forecasting, scoring, clasificación, recomendación).
Experiencia en product analytics / growth analytics (experimentos, atribución, conversión, retención).
Buen criterio para definir métricas (North Star, guardrails) y diseñar reporting útil y accionable.
MongoDB.
Experiencia en cloud (GCP, AWS o Azure): despliegue de pipelines, gestión de servicios gestionados de datos y buenas prácticas de IAM/costes.
Experiencia con algún warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift o similar) y buenas prácticas de versionado/CI.




Qué ofrecemos:

Salario altamente competitivo según experiencia.
Modelo híbrido orientado a productividad.
Servicio de comida y gimnasio.
Presupuesto de formación continua.
Sin burocracia, enfoque a resultados.
Un equipo joven, pragmático y ambicioso centrado en resultados reales y en hacer crecer el negocio.




Si buscas un proyecto ambicioso donde aplicar tus capacidades con resultados visibles, y seguir creciendo en una empresa de rápida expansión, te estamos esperando! 🙌

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
En Keepler (part of Accenture) queremos hacer crecer nuestro equipo con personas que tengan ganas de desarrollar software basado en datos con dos objetivos: ayudar en la transformación a nuestros clientes y disfrutar del proceso de crear valor a través de la tecnología.




Si quieres ser parte de un equipo que te ofrecerá retos tecnológicos y que te exigirá una mejora y aprendizaje continuo, si no tienes miedo a reconocer errores y eres capaz de ser proactivo/a y tirar del carro cuando te toque, es posible que Keepler sea el sitio donde deberías trabajar. ¿Te interesa? Echa un vistazo a nuestra vacante de Analytics Engineer.




¿Qué buscamos en ti?




Al menos 3 años de experiencia como Data Analyst/BI Consultant con un perfil analítico muy marcado.
Alto conocimiento y experiencia en lenguaje SQL y con conocimiento en modelo de datos relacionales.
Experiencia en herramientas de reporting, como Power BI.
Experiencia en nube (AWS y/o Azure).
Capacidad para trabajar con negocio y para entender procesos complejos asociados con datos.
Buena capacidad de trabajo en equipo.
Inglés fluido, nivel alto (B2-C1).
Disponibilidad de desplazarse a las oficinas del cliente de L-V sitadas en Madrid.




Deseable:




Conocimiento de las herramientas complementarias a PowerBI (DAX Studio, Tabular Editor)
Conocimientos sobre el diseño y optimización de bases de datos analíticas.
Experiencia con metodologías Agile.




¿Qué te ofrecemos en Keepler?




Un buen ambiente de trabajo junto a compañeros/as que son unos cracks en sus tecnologías y de quienes aprenderás cada día.
Tendrás un presupuesto personal anual de 2.000 euros para que lo dediques a formación y certificaciones.
Ayuda económica mensual para consumibles del hogar derivados del teletrabajo.
Horario flexible de entrada y salida y flexibilidad en el almuerzo, para que tu vida personal y profesional encajen sin problema.

Retribución flexible para tarjeta transporte, cheque guardería y seguro médico para familiares.
Formación inglés one-to-one gratis para ti, con 8 sesiones al mes en modalidad online.
Seguro médico privado con una amplia cobertura además de seguro dental y ventajas y precio reducido para tus familiares.
Una compañía con una cultura muy colaborativa que siempre piensa en hacerte la vida profesional más fácil para que solo te preocupes en hacer bien lo que te gusta.
Tendrás acompañamiento de un buddy los primeros meses para que te ayude en la adaptación.
Un ambiente solidario y transparente donde tus decisiones afectan a todos/as en la que prima la solidaridad contigo y con el que está a tu lado.

personas con diferentes cualidades, mentes inquietas y deseo de aprender, explorar e implementar nuevas tecnologías que aporten valor a cada proyecto.

Title: Data Analytics Specialist - Transformation
Description:
Location: Madrid, Hybrid

About Swissport

We are a global leader in sustainable and responsible airport services provision, renowned for our unwavering commitment to safety, operational excellence, and exceptional service, shaping a future where air travel thrives on reliability, efficiency, and experience.

In 2023, with the support of more than 60,000 colleagues, Swissport provided best-in-class airport ground services for some 232 million airline passengers and handled roughly 4.7 million tons of air freight at 115 cargo centres. Across a global network that is unparalleled in the industry, Swissport served airlines at 286 airports in 44 countries across six continents.

The culture of Swissport is shaped by our corporate values, which guide our actions and decision-making processes. These values are at the core of our culture, shaping our business and underpinning our commitment to measuring our impact. They capture the essence of who we are at Swissport and help us deliver value across the entire company.

"Show You Care" underlines that our actions are perceived and valued from the perspective of the people around us. So, whatever we do, we do it purposefully and consciously, taking in the perspective of our colleagues, customers, and passengers.

“Doing the right things” means that we do the things that are valuable to our colleagues, customers, and passengers. We are trained to do this safely and trusted to do the right thing in any given situation.

"Win as a Team" highlights the importance of teamwork. Either we win as a team, or we fall as individuals. Together, we can surpass ourselves and handle any situation.

These values capture the essence of who we are and our unwavering commitment to excellence, and give actionable guidance for individual behaviour of employees, leaders, and executives, serving as a compass for how to act and deliver.

Job Summary

Support a major system implementation by extracting, analysing, cleansing, transforming and validating large volumes of data from legacy systems for migration into a new enterprise platform. The successful candidate will ensure data is accurate, complete and fit for purpose by applying data quality standards, business rules and reconciliation processes throughout the migration lifecycle.

Job Responsibilities


Extract high-volume datasets from multiple legacy systems using appropriate database query and extraction tools.
Analyse complex datasets to identify data quality issues, inconsistencies, duplicates and missing information.
Cleanse, standardise and transform data in accordance with agreed business rules and migration specifications.
Prepare and format data for bulk upload into the target system using automated processes and migration tools.
Perform data validation, reconciliation and integrity checks before and after migration activities.
Investigate and resolve data anomalies, working with business stakeholders and technical teams where required.
Develop repeatable extraction, transformation and loading (ETL) processes to improve efficiency and accuracy.
Produce data mapping documentation between source and target systems.
Maintain comprehensive documentation of migration activities, assumptions, data issues and resolutions.
Support multiple migration cycles including trial migrations, user acceptance testing and production cutover.
Monitor data quality metrics and report progress, risks and issues to project management.
Ensure compliance with organisational data governance, security and privacy requirements.
Collaborate with business analysts, solution architects, developers and system owners throughout the migration programme.


Qualifications And Competencies


Required years of experience: 3-5 years
Experience working with large datasets beyond the practical limitations of Excel.
Experience in data migration, system implementation or digital transformation projects.
Strong understanding of data quality, cleansing, validation and reconciliation techniques.
Experience extracting data from relational databases and legacy applications.
Knowledge of data mapping and migration methodologies.
Experience working in structured project environments.
Understanding of data governance principles and information security.
Experience with Dayforce (HRIS/HCM) is preferred.
Advanced SQL for querying and manipulating large datasets.
Experience with SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL or MySQL.
Familiarity with ETL tools or scripting languages such as SSIS, Azure Data Factory, Talend, Informatica, Python or PowerShell.
Ability to work with multi-million-row datasets using appropriate database and analytics tools.
Strong Excel skills for data analysis.
Proven experience developing dashboards, reports and data visualisations using Microsoft Power BI (required).
Highly analytical with excellent attention to detail.
Methodical and organised approach to managing complex data.
Strong problem-solving and investigative skills.
Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Able to work independently and collaboratively within a project team.
Committed to delivering high-quality, accurate data under tight deadlines.


This job description indicates the general nature and level of work expected of the incumbent. It is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the incumbent. Incumbent may be required to perform other related duties.

In 2023, with the support of more than 60,000 colleagues, Swissport provided best-in-class airport ground services for some 232 million airline passengers and handled roughly 4.7 million tons of air freight at 115 cargo centres. Across a global network that is unparalleled in the industry, Swissport served airlines at 286 airports in 44 countries across six continents.

The culture of Swissport is shaped by our corporate values, which guide our actions and decision-making processes. These values are at the core of our culture, shaping our business and underpinning our commitment to measuring our impact. They capture the essence of who we are at Swissport and help us deliver value across the entire company.

"Show You Care" underlines that our actions are perceived and valued from the perspective of the people around us. So, whatever we do, we do it purposefully and consciously, taking in the perspective of our colleagues, customers, and passengers.

“Doing the right things” means that we do the things that are valuable to our colleagues, customers, and passengers. We are trained to do this safely and trusted to do the right thing in any given situation.

"Win as a Team" highlights the importance of teamwork. Either we win as a team, or we fall as individuals. Together, we can surpass ourselves and handle any situation.

These values capture the essence of who we are and our unwavering commitment to excellence, and give actionable guidance for individual behaviour of employees, leaders, and executives, serving as a compass for how to act and deliver.

Job Summary

Support a major system implementation by extracting, analysing, cleansing, transforming and validating large volumes of data from legacy systems for migration into a new enterprise platform. The successful candidate will ensure data is accurate, complete and fit for purpose by applying data quality standards, business rules and reconciliation processes throughout the migration lifecycle.

Job Responsibilities

  • Extract high-volume datasets from multiple legacy systems using appropriate database query and extraction tools.
  • Analyse complex datasets to identify data quality issues, inconsistencies, duplicates and missing information.
  • Cleanse, standardise and transform data in accordance with agreed business rules and migration specifications.
  • Prepare and format data for bulk upload into the target system using automated processes and migration tools.
  • Perform data validation, reconciliation and integrity checks before and after migration activities.
  • Investigate and resolve data anomalies, working with business stakeholders and technical teams where required.
  • Develop repeatable extraction, transformation and loading (ETL) processes to improve efficiency and accuracy.
  • Produce data mapping documentation between source and target systems.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of migration activities, assumptions, data issues and resolutions.
  • Support multiple migration cycles including trial migrations, user acceptance testing and production cutover.
  • Monitor data quality metrics and report progress, risks and issues to project management.
  • Ensure compliance with organisational data governance, security and privacy requirements.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, solution architects, developers and system owners throughout the migration programme.

Qualifications And Competencies

  • Required years of experience: 3-5 years
  • Experience working with large datasets beyond the practical limitations of Excel.
  • Experience in data migration, system implementation or digital transformation projects.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, cleansing, validation and reconciliation techniques.
  • Experience extracting data from relational databases and legacy applications.
  • Knowledge of data mapping and migration methodologies.
  • Experience working in structured project environments.
  • Understanding of data governance principles and information security.
  • Experience with Dayforce (HRIS/HCM) is preferred.
  • Advanced SQL for querying and manipulating large datasets.
  • Experience with SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL or MySQL.
  • Familiarity with ETL tools or scripting languages such as SSIS, Azure Data Factory, Talend, Informatica, Python or PowerShell.
  • Ability to work with multi-million-row datasets using appropriate database and analytics tools.
  • Strong Excel skills for data analysis.
  • Proven experience developing dashboards, reports and data visualisations using Microsoft Power BI (required).
  • Highly analytical with excellent attention to detail.
  • Methodical and organised approach to managing complex data.
  • Strong problem-solving and investigative skills.
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Able to work independently and collaboratively within a project team.
  • Committed to delivering high-quality, accurate data under tight deadlines.

Title: Data & Automation Data Specialist
Description:
About Us:




HBX Group is a leading B2B ecosystem player in the TravelTech space, connecting and empowering businesses in the ever-evolving world of travel. We drive growth for our clients and partners while removing friction from the end-to-end travel experience. Our cloud-based technology platforms offer fast and reliable access to a unique portfolio of travel products & services, while rich data and intelligence seamlessly connect supply and demand worldwide.




We have over more than 3,000 experts worldwide, including specialists on the ground who provide insights and support to boost trading even further, especially in the most hard-to-reach segments. This unique blend of technology, data and passionate people serves as a catalyst for all businesses aiming to unlock their full potential in the travel arena.




HBX Group comprises four best-in-class B2B brands that meet the needs of its growing and diverse client base across 190+ global markets.




We are looking for a Data and Automation Specialist to join our Customer Experience and Automation Team in Palma de Mallorca. The main purpose of the role is to implement and maintain specific data ecosystems using Snowflake/PostgreSQL and build hybrid agentic-deterministic workflows on low-code platforms to optimize efficiency.




MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:

Implement and update data structures on Snowflake following established architectural guidelines, ensuring quality and performance of assigned datasets.
Build and maintain datasets to allow automation of business processes using low-code/no-code platforms like Appian, n8n, Salesforce, and similar tools to integrate reservation systems, CRM, marketing, and customer service platforms.
Develop connections using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to integrate LLMs with external data sources as defined in technical specifications.
Deploy and integrate generative AI models to personalize traveler experiences, automate content creation, manage chatbots, and support predictive analytics for demand and customer behavior.
Collaborate with the Lead and stakeholders to translate business requirements into functional automation workflows and dashboards.
Monitor AI and automation workflows, iterating for improved performance, reliability, and business impact.
Build data queries for visualisations to analyse business processes and monitor change impact.




CANDIDATE PROFILE:

Effective written and verbal communication skills for collaborating with team members and stakeholders.
Strong practical skills in SQL and Python for complex data manipulation, scripting, and automation.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
A strong team player mindset with a proven ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams and foster positive working relationships.
Demonstrated lateral thinking and creativity in solving complex problems and designing innovative automation and AI solutions.
Deep understanding and applied knowledge of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar open standards for integrating LLMs with external systems.
Knowledge of data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR) and a commitment to ethical AI practices.
Familiarity with major cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and BI/data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Proven, hands-on experience designing and managing scalable data solutions in Snowflake or PostgreSQL.
Demonstrated experience building, deploying, and maintaining enterprise-grade workflows on low-code/no-code platforms such as Salesforce, Appian, and/or n8n.
Practical experience developing and consuming REST APIs for complex system integrations in a professional environment.
Previous experience working within an Agile or iterative project management methodology is desirable.
Experience in applying AI for personalization and automation is highly desired, preferably within the tourism or hospitality sector.
Familiarity with using BI and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to create business-facing dashboards.




At HBX Group, we believe diversity fuels innovation and strengthens our mission to make travel a force for good. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities truly make a difference.




You will have the opportunity to work for a company that is going through significant change in becoming the world´s leading travel services provider. We are looking for people that are ready to ride the wave in this exciting journey.




As well as an attractive benefits package you will be able to work:

Within an innovative, engaging and multicultural environment.
Have the opportunity to build strong and lasting business relationships and friendships from around the world.
Have the opportunity in developing your career locally or within one of our beautiful working locations across the globe.

Title: Data Quality Analyst
Description:
About Dwelly

Dwelly is a UK-based, AI-enabled lettings and property management platform growing through a roll-up strategy by acquiring estate agencies and integrating them into a modern technology platform.

As we acquire agencies, we inherit large volumes of operational data from different CRM systems. Every migration introduces differences in data quality, structure, and completeness. Maintaining high-quality production data is critical to ensuring a reliable customer experience.

Position Summary

We're looking for a Data Quality Analyst to own the validation and quality assurance of data migrations into Dwelly.

Your primary responsibility will be reviewing and approving CRM data migrations before they reach production. You'll work closely with backend engineers and migration tooling to ensure imported data is complete, accurate, and internally consistent.

This role combines advanced SQL, data analysis, automated validation, and investigation of real-world data quality issues. You'll design validation queries, identify inconsistencies, investigate unexpected results, and help improve our migration tooling over time.

The ideal candidate has exceptional attention to detail, enjoys investigating data problems, and is comfortable making release decisions based on evidence.

Key Responsibilities


Data Migration Validation Review and approve CRM migration datasets before production deployment by validating completeness, consistency, and overall data quality.
Production Data Quality Review production data updates and validate SQL scripts before execution to ensure large-scale changes are safe and correct.
Data Integrity Verification Develop automated validation queries that detect missing records, duplicate entities, broken relationships, and other integrity issues across migrated datasets.
Migration Reconciliation Compare source CRM exports with Dwelly data to verify successful migration and investigate discrepancies.
Data Investigation Analyse unexpected migration results, identify root causes of inconsistencies, and work with engineers to resolve complex data issues.
Continuous Quality Improvement Identify recurring migration issues and help improve migration processes, validation tooling, and overall data quality standards.


Qualifications And Preferred Background


Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, CTEs, aggregations, window functions, and update scripts
Experience validating production data or large database migrations
Strong understanding of relational databases and data integrity principles
Experience investigating inconsistencies across large datasets
Comfortable comparing data from multiple systems and identifying discrepancies
Ability to design automated validation checks instead of relying on manual inspection
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong ownership mindset with the confidence to approve or reject production data changes
Exceptional attention to detail
Ability to work independently in ambiguous situations
Ability to effectively use modern AI development tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex, or similar) to improve productivity, investigate data issues, generate SQL, automate repetitive tasks, and accelerate analysis while maintaining high standards of accuracy and review.


Technical Environment


PostgreSQL
MySQL
DuckDB (testing and validation)
Git
SQLMesh or dbt
Dolt or similar version-controlled database technologies
CSV-based CRM migrations


Nice to Have


Python for automation and data analysis
Experience building automated data quality frameworks
Knowledge of ETL or ELT pipelines
Experience working with CRM migrations or property management systems
Familiarity with data observability and reconciliation tooling


What Success Looks Like


Production migrations are approved with confidence and minimal manual effort.
Automated validation catches the vast majority of migration issues before deployment.
Data integrity issues are identified early and resolved quickly.
Migration quality improves continuously through better validation and investigation.
Engineers trust the migration approval process because it is evidence-driven, repeatable, and reliable.


Compensation & Benefits:


Fully remote role.
Competitive compensation based on experience and impact.
Opportunity to work on high-leverage automation systems at the intersection of backend engineering, applied ML, data and real operational workflows.
Competitive salary with the potential for equity options based on performance, recognising exceptional contributions to our integration success.


What is it like being a Dwell-er?

Feel free to check out Dwelly Core Principles. That’s about what we believe in, how we operate and make decisions.

What we offer is not a fancy office or a static workplace. Instead, this is about solving one of the world’s most complex problems in the largest consumer industry in the world: residential rentals.

More than 30% of households live in rental homes — over 5 million in the UK and more than 100 million across the EU and US. Our mission is to improve that experience through technology, automation and operational excellence.

This is about disrupting one of the largest and most antiquated industries in the world with one of the strongest operational and technical teams in the UK and Europe.

We work hard, and we aim for extremely ambitious results. We want people to be proud of what they’ve built and to one day look back and say: “Hell yeah, that was me that did it.”

Our Principles


Customer obsession rather than competitive focus
Passion for invention
Operational excellence
Long-term thinking


By applying for this position, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data for recruitment purposes for up to 365 days, in accordance with our data retention policy and applicable data protection laws.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Guesty is the all-in-one platform helping hospitality businesses around the world automate, optimize, and scale their operations. We’re a fast-growing global startup transforming the industry — from enhancing guest experiences to driving business growth.

With a powerful suite of features and integrations with 150+ industry partners, including Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, Expedia, and Google Travel, Guesty empowers property managers to deliver exceptional guest experiences while running efficient, data-driven operations.

Today, we're proud to have 800+ team members across 16 countries, all working together to shape the future of hospitality technology.

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across our Marketing organization. This role will partner closely with Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver actionable insights, develop scalable reporting, analyze campaign performance, and help optimize marketing strategies through data. The ideal candidate has strong SQL expertise, experience with BI tools, and the ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the primary analytics partner for the Marketing team.
Write and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze large datasets.
Build, maintain, and improve dashboards using Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar BI tools.
Analyze marketing performance across Google Ads, Facebook Ads, email, paid search, paid social, and organic channels.
Define, monitor, and report on key marketing KPIs, including ROI, ROAS, CAC, LTV, attribution, conversion rate, marketing spend, and campaign performance.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear business recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities through data analysis.
Partner with Marketing, Product, and Business teams to support strategic decision-making.
Ensure data quality, consistency, and reporting accuracy across dashboards and reports.
Continuously improve reporting processes through automation and scalable analytics solutions.


Requirements:


3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Marketing Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Analytics Analyst.
Expert-level SQL skills with experience writing complex SQL queries (joins, CTEs, window functions, subqueries, aggregations, query optimization, and data transformation). This is a core requirement.
Strong experience using BI and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and identify actionable insights.
Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience building dashboards, reports, and executive-level presentations.
Experience defining and tracking KPIs and business metrics.
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field.
Strong English communication skills.


Highly Preferred


Experience as a Marketing Data Analyst within a SaaS, IT, software, or technology company.
Experience with Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or similar marketing platforms.
Strong understanding of marketing metrics, including: ROI, ROAS, Attribution, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Lifetime Value (LTV), Marketing Spend, Conversion Rate
Experience supporting B2B SaaS marketing teams.
Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift.
Experience with Python or R for data analysis is an advantage.
Experience with AI tools or analytics automation is a plus.

La persona seleccionada formará parte de un equipo transversal y tendrá un rol clave como analista end‑to‑end, combinando análisis ad‑hoc, automatización de procesos, definición de KPIs, construcción de dashboards y participación activa en la migración de nuestros procesos y proyectos al entorno cloud.

Este rol es ideal para alguien con iniciativa, fuerte capacidad analítica, curiosidad y ganas de asumir un papel amplio y de impacto dentro del equipo.

Sus Responsabilidades Incluyen

Gestión de la relación con los clientes (dirección y áreas de negocio)

  • Interlocución habitual con dirección y áreas de negocio para entender necesidades y traducirlas en soluciones basadas en datos.
  • Priorización y planificación de los proyectos y peticiones recurrentes.
  • Gestión de expectativas, seguimiento y comunicación de resultados.

Realización de proyectos en los que se aborda el ciclo completo de análisis de información

  • Toma de requerimientos de información de negocio
  • Exploración de datos en Datapool y/o fuentes externas. Desde la búsqueda hasta el tratamiento de los datos hasta generar la información necesaria
  • Propuesta y generación de KPIs
  • Construcción de los informes / análisis para presentar la información
  • Comunicación de resultados a los clientes
  • Diseño, elaboración, mantenimiento y automatización los procesos para seguimientos recurrentes o peticiones puntuales.

Para Realizar Estas Funciones, Será Necesario

  • Tener conocimientos técnicos para llevar a cabo los informes que se requieran desde negocio
  • Tener cualidades analíticas que permitan entender la lógica de negocio y proponer nuevas ideas o estrategias que ayuden a impulsarlo
  • Buenas habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales, así como creatividad y atención a los detalles en la visualización y comunicación de información.

Requisitos mínimos

  • Licenciatura en carreras de ciencias o ingenierías.
  • Fuertes capacidades de análisis y gestión de datos, con uso de herramientas de análisis y explotación de Bases de datos: alto nivel en SQL, fluidez en Data Discovery y Análisis Estadísticos, Python, GIT, Airflow.
  • Formación en lenguajes de programación.
  • Generación de dashboards con herramientas de visualización como QlikSense, Looker, etc.
  • Nivel avanzado herramientas de ofimática (Excel, Power Point, etc).

Se Valorará Positivamente

  • Experiencia trabajando o analizando experiencia de cliente (NPS, touchpoints, etc.)
  • Experiencia previa en Google Cloud o en otras plataformas cloud (AWS, etc.).
  • Experiencia previa en Banca en departamentos de analítica/BI.

Competencias Clave

  • Gestión de grandes volúmenes de datos
  • Gestión de proyectos de información (relación con clientes y proveedores)
  • Capacidad de traducir requerimientos de negocio en especificaciones técnicas
  • Persona resolutiva, con entusiasmo y compromiso, colaborativa
  • Perfil flexible, con capacidad de adaptación al cambio
  • Buenas habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales
  • Orientación al negocio y a la experiencia de cliente
  • Definición y seguimiento de KPI’s comerciales

  • Itinerario formativo individual con acceso a nuestra plataforma online, que ofrece un extenso catálogo de recursos de autoaprendizaje para fomentar tu crecimiento continuo.
  • Dispondrás de un seguro de salud completo totalmente gratuito para ti. Además, quedarás adherido al Plan de Pensiones, al que CaixaBank realizará aportaciones pensando ya en tu futuro.
  • Retribución flexible aplicada a transporte, formación, idiomas, guardería, entre otros.

Title: Data Analyst Intern
Description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Description

YOUR MISSION

You will be at the heart of Glovo's Global Logistics and Operations team, owning the data work behind how we design, test, and optimize the order compensation structures that reward our riders across 23 countries. This is one of the highest impact areas in the company, rider payments are our largest operational cost, and every model you build or experiment you run translates directly into business outcomes at scale.

The environment is fast moving. Priorities shift and ad hoc requests come in regularly. This internship is built for someone curious, hands-on, and eager to learn how real operational decisions get made with data. You will be paired with experienced analysts who will mentor you along the way.

THE JOURNEY


Support the team in modelling and reviewing order payment structures that improve engagement and operational efficiency.
You will be using SQL to query large datasets to surface trends, answer business questions quickly, and build the analytical foundation for strategic decisions.
Translate findings into action. You will help present insights to non-technical stakeholders in a way that is concise and convincing.
Support the design and running of experiments that validate setting changes before global rollout. You will be exposed to the full cycle: design, execution, and analysis.
Leverage AI in your workflow. You will actively incorporate AI tools (agents, copilots, and LLM-assisted analysis) into your day to day work to move faster and work smarter.
Monitor and iterate. Track KPIs, spot anomalies, and make data driven adjustments on an ongoing basis.
Understand the rider perspective to ensure models are fair, locally relevant, and operationally sound.


Qualifications

WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE


Recently completed a degree or master's in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or another quantitative field.
SQL is essential. You can write queries to pull and filter data, join tables, and aggregate results on your own.
Python familiarity. You can use pandas (or similar) to manipulate data and automate simple tasks.
Excel / spreadsheet familiarity. You know your way around formulas, pivot tables, and structuring data cleanly.
Strong problem-solving instincts. You can take an ambiguous question, break it down, and work toward a clear answer without waiting to be told exactly how.
Fluent English is a must. You communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.


Nice-to-haves


Hands-on experience leveraging AI in your workflow: copilots, agents, or LLM-assisted analysis used to move faster and work smarter.
Exposure to data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
Any exposure to experimentation (A/B testing, switchback tests, or similar).


We Believe Driven Talent Deserves


🍔 Monthly Glovo credit to satisfy your cravings!
💳 Discounts on transportation, food, and even kindergarten expenses.
🏊 Discounted gym memberships to keep you energized.
🏖️ Extra time off, the freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year!
👪 Enhanced parental leave, and office-based nursery.
🧠 Online therapy and wellbeing benefits to ensure your mental well-being.

Strong communication skills required
Ability to work alone or in a team as required

🏢 Hybrid setting, flexible working policy, and great offices in Europe

Title: Business Insights Specialist
Description:
Summary

El/la Business Insights Specialist – Can Tooling lidera las actividades analíticas que dan soporte al rendimiento del negocio, la planificación de la demanda y la estrategia a medio y largo plazo del segmento Can Tooling. El puesto se centra en recopilar y revisar datos internos y externos (ventas, producción, clientes e información de mercado) para garantizar que sean adecuados para el análisis y transformarlos en información accionable.

Entre sus principales responsabilidades se incluyen realizar análisis avanzados para identificar impulsores del negocio, tendencias y oportunidades; desarrollar y mantener modelos predictivos y previsiones de ingresos (incluidos los próximos tres meses); diseñar cuadros de mando e informes para supervisar indicadores clave; y dar soporte a la definición y seguimiento de la estrategia de precios. La persona actuará como referente analítico del equipo, apoyará la priorización de pedidos para contribuir a maximizar los ingresos mensuales y colaborará estrechamente con Producción, Ventas y Dirección como socio/a clave transversal

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Las principales responsabilidades de esta posición incluirán:


Recopilación y calidad de datos para el análisis
Recopilar y consolidar datos internos y externos relevantes (por ejemplo, ventas, producción, datos de clientes, informes de mercado, informes de visitas del equipo de Ventas, publicaciones y estudios de mercado) adaptados a las necesidades del segmento Can Tooling.
Análisis de negocio e insights
Analizar datos para identificar los principales impulsores del negocio, tendencias de rendimiento, riesgos y oportunidades para el segmento Can Tooling.
Segmentar a los clientes de Can Tooling en función de KPIs de valor y otros criterios relevantes para apoyar iniciativas comerciales y estratégicas.
Convertir resultados analíticos complejos en conclusiones y recomendaciones claras, concisas y prácticas para los directivos y las partes interesadas.
Actuar como referente analítico del equipo, proporcionando orientación sobre análisis, cuadros de mando e interpretación de resultados.
Liderar proyectos de modelización predictiva y forecasting
Desarrollar, mejorar y mantener modelos predictivos para prever la demanda futura de productos y apoyar la alineación de la capacidad con la demanda futura.
Elaborar y mantener previsiones de ingresos para los próximos tres meses, actualizándolas a medida que haya nueva información disponible.
Utilizar los resultados predictivos y de forecasting para apoyar la toma de decisiones en áreas como el desarrollo de mercado, la planificación de la demanda y la priorización de pedidos.
Cuadros de mando e informes
Preparar, actualizar y mejorar cuadros de mando de seguimiento del negocio utilizando datos de Hyperion (DW) y otras herramientas analíticas para supervisar indicadores clave relevantes para el segmento Can Tooling.
Soporte a ingresos y colaboración transversal
Colaborar estrechamente con Ventas, Producción y Dirección como socio/a analítico/a clave, garantizando que los insights, previsiones y cuadros de mando apoyen decisiones basadas en datos y la alineación estratégica.
Participar en conversaciones e iniciativas relacionadas con el desarrollo de mercado y la estrategia de ventas de valor añadido desde una perspectiva analítica.
Definición y seguimiento de la estrategia de precios
Definir y apoyar la estrategia de precios para el segmento Can Tooling, garantizando su alineación con los objetivos de negocio, el posicionamiento de mercado, el valor para el cliente y los objetivos de rentabilidad.
Supervisar la implementación y efectividad de la estrategia de precios analizando su impacto en indicadores clave del negocio como ingresos, precio bruto, beneficio bruto y evolución del margen.
Realizar el seguimiento de la evolución de precios por cliente, producto, mercado y segmento, destacando tendencias relevantes y proporcionando insights y recomendaciones claras para apoyar la toma de decisiones.
Colaborar con Ventas, Dirección y otros stakeholders relevantes para garantizar que las decisiones y acciones relacionadas con precios estén basadas en datos, sean comercialmente sólidas y estén alineadas con la estrategia general del negocio.



Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education And/or Work Experience


Grado y máster preferiblemente en Ingeniería Industrial o Gestión Industrial.
Se valorará muy positivamente experiencia en Excel, Power Query, PBI y modelado de bases de datos.
Al menos 1 año de experiencia trabajando en Product Management.
Nivel avanzado de inglés. Se valorarán muy positivamente otros idiomas.



Technical Skills/Physical Requirements


Actitud proactiva
Gran atención al detalle
Capacidad para trabajar en un entorno dinámico
Orientación al cliente
Iniciativa empresarial
Espíritu de equipo

Title: Data Analyst, External Fulfillment EU
Description:
Description

The EU External Fulfillment Ops Excellence team is looking for a hands-on, detail oriented and highly motivated Data Analyst to help create data backed insights. The data analyst will be responsible to analyze data to support support programs, dig deep into data to determine root cause of defects, build and maintain decision support tools, and present findings to business partners. In addition the Data Analyst will also be responsible for maintaining key metrics for business reviews.

Key job responsibilities


Assist in retrieving and aggregating data from multiple sources to support decision-making processes
Help maintain and review KPIs on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis
Support the EU External Fulfillment Network with basic data requests
Contribute to data analysis that informs recommendations for EU EF Leadership
Participate in data mining and basic problem-solving tasks


A day in the life

This position is office-based.

Every day is different in this role. The work you’ll conduct is both proactive and reactive, requiring you to analyse the capacity per truck for the transportation network and work quickly to resolve any operational issues. You will find improvement opportunities and implement them in the network. If you’re looking to develop your career, you’ll be able to access development and mentorship opportunities to help you progress at Amazon.

Based at one of our sites, you'll be where the action is and work in an environment that encourages collaboration with a variety of internal and external stakeholders. By tapping into the latest performance indicators and metrics, you'll help us unlock our network's full potential.

Basic Qualifications


Experience in data analysis
Speak, write, and read fluently in English
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel


Preferred Qualifications


Ability to work in a team environment
Problem solving experience
Ability to work independently
Experience with basic data analysis and reporting
Knowledge of Amazon systems and processes
Strong organizational skills
Interest in learning new technical tools
Basic understanding of data visualization concepts
Ability to maintain attention to detail
Good communication skills

Description:
Job Description

Job Title: Data Analyst Excel

Job Type: Contract

Location: Remote

Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Key Responsibilities


Conduct in-depth data analysis using Microsoft Excel to extract actionable insights and support decision-making across teams.
Collaborate with project stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into meaningful analyses.
Review, clean, and validate datasets to ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
Develop clear, concise reports and visualizations to communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities in complex datasets, contributing to strategic initiatives.
Document methodologies, results, and recommendations with meticulous attention to detail.
Contribute expertise to enhance data-driven decision-making processes within the customer's team.


Required Skills And Qualifications


Proven experience performing data analysis in a business environment using Microsoft Excel as the primary tool.
Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in data processing and reporting.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate analytical findings.
Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across teams to drive business outcomes.
Solid understanding of Excel functions, formulas, and data visualization tools.
Proficiency in identifying data inconsistencies and implementing corrective measures.
Experience working in fast-paced, data-driven organizations.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting cross-functional teams with data insights to inform business strategy.
Background in presenting analytical outcomes to diverse audiences.
Familiarity with additional data analysis tools or business intelligence platforms.

Title: Data Analyst - Ops
Description:
Embark on an exciting career journey with Optima, recognized as one of the 1000 fastest-growing companies in Europe. We are currently seeking a highly skilled Data Analyt to join our vibrant team.




About Us:




At Optima, we've had a front row seat to the fundamental changes of this industry we know and love. Whether it's a move from third-party data to first-party data, being ahead of the curve in programmatic, and preparing for a new cookieless world, we pride ourselves in removing the hassle. Our publishers can count on revenue streams that are optimized and predictable, so they can continue doing what they do best: inform and entertain global consumers.




Job Description

As a Data Analyst, you'll own the numbers behind our publisher portfolio. You'll turn raw programmatic data into decisions: which publishers to onboard, where revenue is leaking, which levers move yield, and what our commercial teams should do next.

This is a high-ownership role with direct, measurable impact on revenue. You'll work daily with Business Development, Operations, and Demand, and you'll build deep expertise in the programmatic supply chain — SSPs, DSPs, header bidding, ads.txt — from day one. If you want to become genuinely fluent in ad tech data, there are few faster ways to do it.




Responsibilities:




Analysis & insight

Analyze prospective publishers: size the revenue opportunity, model expected yield, and pressure-test assumptions before we commit
Run deep-dive analyses on portfolio performance — yield by placement, format, geo, device, and demand partner — and translate findings into concrete recommendations
Build and maintain the metrics that define how we measure success, and defend their definitions when they're questioned
Identify patterns across publishers that others miss: seasonality, demand-partner behavior, bid-density shifts, traffic-quality signals

Performance monitoring & optimization

Monitor daily performance across the portfolio (impressions, fill rate, CPM, CTR, viewability, revenue) against targets
Catch underperformance early, diagnose root causes with data rather than intuition, and make or recommend the adjustments that fix it
Troubleshoot delivery and discrepancy issues with internal teams and external partners, tracing numbers back through the stack to find where they diverge




Publisher onboarding, technical integration and account operations

Support technical setup of new publishers: ads.txt, ad tags, header bidding configuration, and QA before go-live
Assist the Business Development team with new-publisher onboarding and keep the new-business pipeline data accurate and up to date in our CRM
Support adoption of our sales tools and processes across the region

Data quality & reporting

Own the integrity of our reporting layer: audit dashboards and data sources regularly, reconcile discrepancies between platforms, and escalate anomalies fast
Automate recurring reporting so the team spends its time on decisions, not on assembling spreadsheets
Produce clear, accurate performance reporting for publishers and internal stakeholders — and make sure the story the numbers tell is the right one
Surface insights and trends that feed commercial and product decisions
Onboarding & technical integration
Support the technical setup of new publishers: ads.txt, ad tags, header bidding configuration, and QA before go-live
Work with Business Development on new-publisher onboarding, and keep pipeline data accurate and current in our CRM










Required Skills and Qualifications:

Strong analytical skills, identify trends and make data-driven decisions and knowledge of the ad-tech universe.
Proficiency with office productivity tools; ability to quickly adapt to new software and systems.
Proficiency in ad serving platforms.
Commitment to maintaining confidentiality regarding company and employee information.
Fluent in English.



Benefits:

Hybrid work model from our Barcelona office. (3 days at the office / 2 days remote)
Remote working during August.
Real ownership from week one, with structured onboarding and mentorship from senior operators.
A clear growth path.
Front-row exposure to a fast-scaling company working with leading publishers.
Paid team lunch every week.

About The Team

Kiloverse is the operational force that helps ventures grow — building the systems, teams, and infrastructure that turn ideas into scalable businesses. Behind every fast-growing product, there’s a group of people who think like owners, act fast, and execute with precision.

Here, you’ll find people who want to break big in their careers — working side by side with entrepreneurs and founders to build ventures that redefine the health, wellness, beauty, or travel industries.

Data team, as part of Kiloverse, the operational force behind every impactful Kilo solution, provides advanced data engineering, modelling and reporting solutions for the whole group.

Get ready to


Identify, investigate and solve data issues: data quality, data discrepancies, missing data
Contribute to the development and improvement of data solutions
Leverage the power of dbt for overcoming complex modelling problems with a focus on performance, robustness and scalability
Employ GCP tools (dbt, Airflow and Looker) to enhance data quality, efficiency, and delivery of accurate and timely data
Work on prevention and alerting solutions
Adopt and refine our best practices e.g. naming convention, data modeling, and data quality testing
Communicate with cross-functional teams and non-technical stakeholders in a clear and structured manner
Assist and support other team members in the design, development, and implementation of data warehousing, reporting, and analytics solutions
Take ownership of tasks and initiatives


We expect you to


Have at least 4 years of proven SQL skills: ability to join and manipulate data of various types (String, Integer, JSON, Array), write parameterized scripts, debug SQL code

Experience with analytics tracking tools (e.g., Snowplow, GA4) is a strong plus

Have strong communication skills: timely, clear, and consistent sharing of information, work progress, bottlenecks and findings
Have curious and growth-oriented mindset towards constant learning

Be fluent in English.

Location

Choose between our Vilnius headquarters or our Kaunas hub — two great spaces designed for doing your best work.

Shape your growth path

Builders never stop learning. Coaching, mentorship, training, conferences, online courses, subscriptions, books – you’ve got a €1100 yearly budget to fuel personal or team growth. You pick the path – we’ll back you all the way.

Drive global impact

This is where ambition scales. Build impact across 30+ brands worldwide. Launch bold projects. Even step in as a co-founder – we reward those who push further. And if you bring in more great people, you get €1500 for every successful referral.

Title: Data Analyst - People & Product
Description:
Hi! 👋

At Factorial we're on the lookout for a Data Analyst to raise the bar on how we turn data into decisions across the business 🚀.

The Role ✨

At Factorial, data sits at the heart of every decision we make — and we're looking for a Data Analyst to make it count where it matters most: our people.

This is a hybrid role that combines two profiles — the responsibilities of an Analytics Engineer and those of a Data Analyst. As an Analytics Engineer, you model and structure data in the gold layer with DBT, turning raw tables into reliable, documented models a whole business area can trust. As a Data Analyst, you build advanced analysis on top of them, own the metrics they expose, and deliver the reporting the business runs on — carrying out dashboards and ad-hoc deep-dives that turn open questions into decisions, hand in hand with Business.

You'll focus primarily on our People area — our biggest opportunity — bringing a data-driven approach to how we understand, hire, and grow our teams, and shaping high-stakes decisions across talent acquisition, headcount planning, engagement, and performance. You'll also partner with Product, helping define how we iterate the product and turning data into real impact on pricing, packaging, and usage.

Factorial is a fast-paced scale-up in constant evolution — some areas are still building their data foundations while others are already driven by the power of data . You won't inherit a finished playbook; you'll write it, raising the analytical bar as the company grows. If you're driven by curiosity, energized by ambiguity, and want ownership of both the data model and the decisions it drives, this one's for you

What You'll Be Doing


Own the data models: Design, build, and maintain the gold-layer models (DBT) that become the single source of truth for your business area — with the tests and documentation that keep them trusted and reused across teams.
Own metrics and governance: Define and document your area's KPIs, resolve conflicting definitions across teams, and maintain a single source of truth others are expected to use.
Treat dashboards as a product: Build reporting in Power BI with clear ownership, and keep iterating on it based on how it's actually used.
Go beyond dashboards: Run the advanced analysis that answers the "why" — cohort and retention analyses, impact modeling, and scenario / forecasting — and turn findings into concrete product, pricing, or lifecycle recommendations.
Enable decision-making: Partner with Business and Product teams to turn ambiguous questions into the right analysis, and run the work that determines whether a decision actually moved the needle.
Foster business–data collaboration: Embed with your stakeholders, build a shared language around metrics, and strengthen how the business and the Data team work together — so data becomes a habit, not an afterthought.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with Data Science, Data Engineering, and Analytics Engineers to keep data integrity high, prepare the layer models consume, and translate model outputs into metrics the business understands.
Master data storytelling: Turn analysis into clear narratives that align stakeholders and inspire action — so the work actually changes what people do.


What We're Looking For

You're likely a great fit if you:


Have 3+ years in Analytics Engineering, BI, or Data Analyst roles — ideally in a fast-paced, scaling tech environment.
Write fluent, independent SQL — you can model and debug complex queries on your own, without waiting on review.
Are comfortable with Python for analysis and lightweight data workflows.
Know your way around DBT and a layered / medallion modeling approach (bronze / silver / gold).
Have shipped a BI tool in production, Power BI ideally (or an equivalent like Looker / Tableau).
Have solid advanced-analytics fundamentals: cohort and retention analysis, segmentation, funnel and driver analysis, and experimentation (A/B) backed by a solid statistics background.
Use version control (Git / GitHub) as part of your normal workflow.
Are business-minded and communicate with impact — you understand what stakeholders really need (not just what they ask for), reframe the question, and translate complex data into clear, actionable insight that drives decisions.
Are autonomous, proactive, and detail-oriented — you see ambiguity as an opportunity, not a blocker.
Treat the metrics and models you build as products, not one-off deliverables.
Have English working proficiency.


Bonus Points if You:


Understand subscription or product-based (SaaS) economics and can connect data work to revenue, growth, and retention outcomes.
Have owned a metrics framework that became the reference.
Have partnered closely with Data Science to bring models into production and translate their output into business decisions.
Have helped build or scale an analytics function — tooling, modeling and documentation standards, processes, and KPI frameworks — leaving it more mature than you found it.

At Factorial, data sits at the heart of every decision we make — and we're looking for a Data Analyst to make it count where it matters most: our people.

This is a hybrid role that combines two profiles — the responsibilities of an Analytics Engineer and those of a Data Analyst. As an Analytics Engineer, you model and structure data in the gold layer with DBT, turning raw tables into reliable, documented models a whole business area can trust. As a Data Analyst, you build advanced analysis on top of them, own the metrics they expose, and deliver the reporting the business runs on — carrying out dashboards and ad-hoc deep-dives that turn open questions into decisions, hand in hand with Business.

About Us

With over 185 years of history, we are a leading health and wellness company. Our portfolio includes iconic brands such as Aquilea, Fisiocrem, Laborest, Sidroga, Biodramina, Aerored, Fave de Fuca, Halibut, Ems, and Depuralina, with a strong presence across major European markets.

We believe in the power of nature, enhanced by science, as the best way to improve human health and wellbeing sustainably. Our goal is to create a positive impact on both people's lives and the planet. We are currently seeking a highly motivated and skilled Data Analyst to join our team.




Your Mission

We are currently looking to strengthen our Data team by appointing a Data Analyst who will play a key role in designing and delivering scalable, high-quality reporting solutions across the organization. As part of the Data Department, you will work cross-functionally with business stakeholders and Data Engineering, acting as a trusted partner between data and decision-making. You will lead end-to-end analytics projects, drive best practices, and contribute to the continuous evolution of our data platform while mentoring more junior team members.




Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will be expected to:

Lead end-to-end reporting projects autonomously, from requirements gathering and data modeling to development, validation, and deployment in Power BI
Design and maintain optimized semantic data models (e.g., star schema, reusable DAX measures) to support multiple business use cases
Act as an analytical business partner, proactively identifying insights, KPIs, and opportunities beyond initial stakeholder requests
Ensure data quality, consistency, and performance of dashboards, troubleshooting and optimizing complex models when needed
Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to define and improve data models and architectures aligned with reporting needs
Drive reporting automation, documentation standards, and support/mentor business users and junior analysts in dashboard usage and best practices




You'll excel if you have...

3–5 years of experience in Data Analyst, BI Analyst, or similar roles, with at least 2 years of hands-on experience working intensively with Power BI in production environments
Advanced expertise in Power BI, including semantic modeling, intermediate-advanced DAX (time intelligence, filter context, CALCULATE, variables), Power Query (M), and performance optimization
Strong SQL skills (complex queries with multiple joins, CTEs, window functions, subqueries, and advanced aggregations), combined with solid knowledge of dimensional data modeling (star schema, SCDs, granularity)
Experience designing reports for different audiences (operational to executive), applying best practices in data visualization and storytelling
Strong ownership and autonomy, with the ability to lead projects end-to-end, manage multiple priorities, and ensure high-quality outputs with rigorous attention to detail
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to challenge requirements and translate business needs into scalable analytical solutions
A proactive, curious, and improvement-driven mindset, with experience mentoring junior profiles and collaborating across technical and non-technical teams
Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks), Medallion architectures (Bronze/Silver/Gold), version control (Git), or DataOps practices is a plus
Experience with other BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Qlik), systems such as SAP/Salesforce/Odoo, or programming in Python for data analysis is considered an advantage
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Administration, Economics, or equivalent; relevant certifications (e.g., PL-300, DP-600) are a plus
Fluent English (minimum B2 spoken) and Spanish, additional languages are a plus

Title: Associate Data Analyst
Description:
Ready to make an impact in the connected vehicle and telematics industry through data?

As an Associate Data Analyst at Webfleet, a Bridgestone company, you'll turn complex data into actionable insights that support business decisions. Working within the Marketing Strategy team, you'll analyze product, sales, revenue, pricing, customer, and usage data to create reports and dashboards that drive business performance.

You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams including data analysts, product managers, marketers, sales, customer success, and business managers to deliver reliable reporting and analytics.

Your day-to-day:

As an Associate Data Analyst, you are on the forefront driving business results by generating data-based insights.


Data mining and data analyses to generate new insights for well-informed business decisions with the stakeholder support.
Collect data from multiple sources and databases and consolidate it in a single data source to generate business reports (usually Power BI, but also Tableau, Salsforce reports, or simliar visualization tools)
Identify, analyze, and interpret trends in complex datasets.
Develop powerful reports and business dashboards with excellent user experience to take business decisions.
Steering efforts to exploit new data types and sources internally.
Project Management of business initiatives end-2-end. For example, prepare analytics but also prepare presentation to defend the topic in front of the business unit management, initially with the coach and support of a team lead.
Business Analysis Capabilities: Analytical Problem-Solving capabilities, Ability to conduct Interpersonal and consultative interactions, excellent oral and written communication.
Close collaboration with Line of Business Management, sales teams, customer success, Product Managers, data scientists, marketeers, data engineers and analysts to improve business performance on KPIs as customer upsell and churn, prospecting, and rich-data content generation.



Who are you?

There is no set route to become our new Associate Data Analyst. But to be successful in this role, this is the kind of profile we have in mind:


You have at least 3 years’ experience in building dashboards and handling data sets, including DAX, Power Query, data modelling, and Power BI Service (workspace management, report publishing, app publishing, and scheduled refreshes).
You can utilize several data sources, especially relational databases. This includes having knowledge in SQL.
You have experience visualizing and presenting data utilizing Power BI (Marketing Cloud Intelligence, Tableau, QlickView, are a plus).
You have knowledge in DAX Formulas, Power Query and , data modelling, and data visualization, since this will be part of the day to day job.
Be ready to be exposed to frameworks, standards, and software categories such as Azure or similar.
Personal must-haves: problem-solving skills, analytic mind, aim to learn, flexible thinking, accountability, and good communication skills.
Bachelors in science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics or Economics degree, with special focus on data analytics or and statistics.
Fluent in English. Additional language is a plus.
Would be a plus:
Experience with Salesforce or other CRM platforms, Mixpanel, and reporting tools.
Knowledge of statistics, Python (or another object-oriented programming language), and basic machine learning concepts.
Familiarity with Scrum or other Agile ways of working.
Ability to independently own projects and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.



Why you’ll love working for us:


The chance to work in a fast moving, innovative and international team, dealing with different countries and cultures;
A company culture that likes to work hard and play hard. We like to have fun. There is no sense coming to a job everyday if you don’t like the people you work with;
Decisive actions. We don’t like to wait. It’s in our DNA to move forward. So, it only makes sense that we don’t jam the company with lots of layers. We make things happen. Quickly.



Let’s not forget the good stuff!


Working from home up to 3 days a week.
500 euros gross to set up your home office and additional monthly home office allowance
Chance to work abroad for 40 working days per year
Birthday off and volunteering time off.
Additional health and dental insurance.
100% employer funded pension scheme.
Lunch, childcare or transportation vouchers.
Unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning.
Access to Gofluent platform to learn new languages.
Free access to CALM (top mental health app).
Employee Assistance Program.
Discount on Bridgestone tyres.



Who are we?

Webfleet is Bridgestone’s globally trusted fleet management solution. More than 50,000 businesses across the world use it to improve fleet efficiency, support drivers, boost safety, stay compliant and work more sustainably. For more than 25 years it has been empowering fleet managers with data-driven insights that help them optimize their operations.

Webfleet contributes towards the delivery of The Bridgestone E8 Commitment. This broad, global corporate commitment clearly defines the value Bridgestone is promising to deliver to society, customers and future generations in eight focus areas: Energy, Ecology, Efficiency, Extension, Economy, Emotion, Ease and Empowerment. Title: Data Analyst Intern
Description:
Overview

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

Responsibilities

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Customer Master Data & Business Analyst Intern to join our team in Barcelona. This internship offers hands-on experience working with business data, customer data management, reporting, pricing analytics, process improvement, and data-driven decision-making while collaborating with cross-functional teams across a global organization.

Key Responsibilities


Assist in collecting, cleaning, validating, and maintaining customer and business data from multiple sources.
Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, business insights, and opportunities for process improvement.
Create dashboards, reports, KPIs, and data visualizations for internal stakeholders and business leaders.
Support ongoing analytics, reporting, pricing, and customer master data projects, as well as ad-hoc data requests.
Help automate recurring reports and improve data management and business processes.
Support quotation analysis, reporting activities, and approval workflows.
Collaborate with global teams to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and operational efficiency.
Document methodologies, business processes, assumptions, and data definitions.


Qualifications

Must Have


Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field, with the ability to sign a full-time 12-month internship agreement through the university.
Basic knowledge of data analysis concepts, reporting, and statistical methods.
Experience with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and a structured approach to work.
Strong communication skills in English.
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative and international environment.


Nice to Have


Experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker).
Basic knowledge of databases, SQL, and data modeling.
Experience creating reports, dashboards, or KPI tracking.
Interest in customer data management, pricing, business operations, or process improvement.

Title: Launch Management Data Analyst
Description:
About the job

Farmak International is looking for an Analyst to join our Launch Management team.







Your Mission

The Analyst is responsible for supporting launch planning and execution through data management, reporting, and system maintenance, with a primary focus on Planisware PPM or a similar tool.

The role ensures high-quality, accurate, and timely data across all launch projects, enabling effective decision-making, KPI tracking, and portfolio visibility.

The Analyst contributes to achieving launch performance targets by maintaining reliable data, supporting governance processes, and ensuring consistency across systems and trackers.




Responsibilities




Participate in the implementation and maintenance of Planisware PPM tool.
Maintain and update launch project data in Planisware PPM, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
Support the creation and maintenance of project plans, timelines, and milestones in Planisware.
Ensure alignment and consistency between Planisware, Bookmark GE (Strategic Model), and Launch Trackers.
Maintain and update the Strategic Model / Bookmark GE file with accurate launch data.
Support the preparation and consolidation of data for Pre-IBP and Launch Meetings.
Track and monitor launch KPIs (timelines, readiness status, budget vs. actual performance).
Prepare dashboards, reports, and data analyses for the Launch Management Director and stakeholders.
Identify data inconsistencies and follow up with stakeholders to ensure data quality.
Support risk and issue tracking through accurate data reporting.
Assist in portfolio analysis and performance tracking across launches.
Ensure proper documentation and data traceability across systems.
Support the continuous improvement of tools, templates, and reporting proceses.







Qualifications




Required




University degree in Business, Life Sciences, Data Analytics, or a related field.
1–3 years of experience in data analysis, project coordination, or similar roles.
Experience working with data management and reporting tools.
Fluency in English.







Valued




Master’s degree (Business Analytics, Finance, Pharma, or related fields).
Experience with the implementation or maintenance of Planisware PPM tool (strong advantage).
Experience in pharmaceutical or regulated environments.
Experience supporting project or portfolio management activities.
Familiarity with launch processes or commercial operations.







Why Join Us?

At Farmak International, you’ll be part of a dynamic and growing global environment where data plays a critical role in bringing products to market successfully. As a Launch Management Data Analyst, you will have direct visibility into strategic initiatives and contribute to high-impact decisions across regions and functions. If you are passionate about data, enjoy working cross-functionally, and want to be part of a team that directly influences business success, this is a great opportunity to grow and make a difference!

Anàlisi de la variabilitat de la pràctica clínica en procediments quirúrgics amb llista d’espera per determinar a les pràctiques de poc valor.
Modelització dels factors que influeixen en la incapacitat temporal general i en especial en la salut mental.
Models estadístics per determinar la classificació de la cartera de serveis a nivell hospitalari. 
Execució dels encàrrecs/projectes relacionats amb l’avaluació de la qualitat i acompliment del sistema de salut.



Requisits:


Titulació universitària de llicenciatura o grau en Grau en Estadística o Matemàtiques.
Es valorarà formació addicional en ciència de dades, bioestadística, salut pública, epidemiologia/metodologia de la recerca o avaluació de serveis sanitaris.
Coneixements de programaris per a l’anàlisi estadística (R, R Studio).
És imprescindible estar en possessió del certificat nivell C1 de català.
Les persones interessades a formar part d’aquest procés hauran d’inscriure’s a través del formulari d’inscripció de l’oferta, que es troba a la web d’AQuAS. La sol·licitud s’ha d’acompanyar del currículum en format AQuAS i els documents acreditatius dels requisits.

Experiència professional en l’elaboració i publicació d’estudis observacionals en l’àmbit de la salut, l’ús de dades massives i visualització avançada.
Experiència i/o coneixements del model de gestió del Sistema Sanitari de Catalunya.
Coneixements de programaris de ciència de dades i visualització (Business Objects, Microstrategy, SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Shiny).
