Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At OnTheGoSystems, we're building AI systems that help people translate content across many languages. Our LLM team works with AI-generated translations, user edits, customer feedback, and quality data to continuously improve translation quality.

We're looking for a Data Analyst who enjoys solving open-ended problems, finding patterns in complex datasets, and turning data into practical recommendations. This is not a reporting role. You'll decide what to measure, investigate why things happen, and help the team make better decisions based on evidence.

What You'll Do

You'll own analytical problems from start to finish.

For example, you may discover that users edit translations much more often for one language pair than another. Instead of simply reporting it, you'll investigate why. You'll form hypotheses, gather the data, test possible explanations, and recommend the next steps.

Your work will include:


Defining meaningful metrics for translation quality, AI performance, and user behavior
Monitoring trends and identifying unusual patterns or quality issues
Turning observations into structured investigations and testing multiple hypotheses
Extracting and combining data from SQL databases, NoSQL databases, logs, APIs, and CSV exports
Comparing results across language pairs, AI models, providers, customers, content types, traffic levels, and other dimensions
Separating real signals from coincidence by validating findings with data
Reviewing translation samples to confirm whether patterns represent genuine quality issues
Investigating root causes and recommending practical improvements
Evaluating multilingual AI output for meaning, terminology, tone, formality, grammar, pronouns, and consistency
Using AI tools, dictionaries, and other resources to investigate languages you don't speak, while recognizing when expert linguistic input is needed
Reviewing AI-generated analyses, identifying incorrect conclusions, and helping improve our automated evaluation systems
Building repeatable reports, scripts, and monitoring processes
Communicating findings clearly to developers, product managers, and linguists


Requirements


Strong analytical thinking, curiosity, and attention to detail
The ability to work independently and define what should be investigated
Experience turning open-ended questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations
A solid understanding of metrics, segmentation, distributions, correlations, and the difference between correlation and causation
Experience writing SQL, Python, or similar scripts to collect, clean, and analyze data
Experience working with multiple data sources, including databases, logs, APIs, and exported datasets
Strong hands-on experience using AI tools while critically evaluating their output
Fluent English plus at least one additional language (preferably European), with the ability to assess translation quality and explain language issues
Clear written communication and the ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical colleagues


Bonus points for experience with:


Translation quality or localization
Multilingual content
Data visualization or business intelligence tools


Benefits

You'll work on real AI systems used by customers around the world and directly influence how we measure and improve machine translation quality.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys exploring difficult questions, testing ideas, and discovering insights that aren't immediately obvious. You'll have the freedom to propose your own analyses and the responsibility to turn them into evidence-based recommendations.

What We Offer


100% remote work
Body & Mind Movement program
Home office computer budget
Kindle with access to our company library
Local public holidays respected
Excellent opportunities for growth
Collaboration with talented colleagues across the globe


If you're excited by data, languages, AI, and solving complex problems, apply now, and we'd love to hear from you!

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Data Engineer (Databricks, Spark & Cloud Data Platforms)



Global Insurance Leader | Investment Management



Our key partner, a leading international insurer, is seeking an experienced Data Engineer to join its Investment Management technology team in the Barcelona area.

This is an exciting opportunity to become part of a global function responsible for delivering critical investment data capabilities that support portfolio management, reporting, analytics, and investment decision-making across the business. The successful candidate will play a key role in the development of a strategic cloud-based data platform that leverages Bloomberg and other financial data sources to drive value across the organisation.

Working alongside investment professionals, data specialists, and technology teams across multiple regions, you will help build and enhance a rapidly growing data ecosystem at the heart of the company's investment operations.



The Role



As a Data Engineer, you will help design, develop, and maintain a modern investment data platform built on cloud technologies. You will be responsible for engineering scalable data pipelines, enhancing data architecture, and supporting the delivery of trusted, high-quality data to investment stakeholders globally.

This position would suit an individual who enjoys working in a collaborative environment, solving complex data challenges, and building enterprise-grade solutions using modern cloud and big data technologies.



Key Responsibilities


Design and develop scalable cloud-based data solutions for investment management.
Build and optimise data pipelines using Python, Apache Spark, and Databricks.
Develop and maintain robust data models and database architectures.
Integrate and manage data from Bloomberg and other financial data providers.
Support reporting, analytics, and data-driven decision-making across investment teams.
Ensure data quality, governance, performance, and reliability across the platform.
Collaborate with global business and technology stakeholders to deliver strategic initiatives.
Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the firm's investment data architecture.


Required Experience


Proven experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or Software Engineer.
Strong hands-on experience with Python, Apache Spark, and Databricks.
Experience designing and supporting cloud-based data platforms and architectures.
Strong understanding of ETL/ELT processes and modern data engineering principles.
Experience working with large-scale data environments and complex datasets.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


Desirable Experience


Experience within Insurance, Asset Management, Investments, Banking, or Financial Services.
Exposure to Bloomberg or other market data platforms.
Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Knowledge of investment operations, portfolio analytics, or financial reporting environments.


Location Requirements


Candidates must be based in Barcelona or the surrounding area, or be willing to relocate.
Hybrid working arrangement with regular onsite collaboration expected.


What's on Offer?


Opportunity to join a globally recognised insurance organisation.
Work on a strategic, business-critical investment data platform.
Exposure to cutting-edge cloud and data technologies.
International environment with global stakeholders.
Long-term career growth and development opportunities.
Collaborative, innovative, and technology-driven culture.

If you are passionate about building modern data platforms and leveraging data to support investment decision-making, we would be delighted to discuss this opportunity with you.


Desired Skills and Experience

3+ years of Data Engineering experience including 2+ years designing and building Databricks data pipelines is required; Azure cloud is highly preferred, however will consider AWS, GCP or other cloud platform experience in lieu.

Experience with conceptual, logical and/or physical database designs is a plus

2+ years of hands-on Python/Pyspark/SparkSQL and/or Scala experience is required

2+ years of experience with Big Data pipelines or DAG Tools (Data Factory, Airflow, dbt, or similar) is required

2+ years of Spark experience (especially Databricks Spark and Delta Lake) is required

2+ years of hands-on experience implementing Big Data solutions in a cloud ecosystem, including Data/Delta Lakes, is required

2+ years of SQL experience, specifically to write complex, highly optimized queries across large volumes of data is highly desired

Experience working in a controlled environment with Github and CI/CD release pipelines is highly desired

Experience with financial data providers such as Bloomberg in an asset/investment management firm or other financial service company is highly desired but not essential

Experience with AI, LLMs, Databricks Genie or similar tools is required

Must be comfortable speaking English

A positive attitude and a 'can do' mentality is essential

Title: Staff Data Analyst
Description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

At Preply, data is at the heart of every decision we make. We run hundreds of analysis to continually optimize our product, each with its own analytical and tracking challenges. The complexity of our subscription model, along with the unique dynamics of tutor-learner interactions, offers an exciting opportunity for those looking to make a real impact.

As a Staff Data Analyst , you will own the data strategy for a critical product domain (e.g., Growth, Retention, Marketplace) and act as the senior analytical authority in that space. You will partner with Directors and VPs across Business, Operations, Product, and Engineering to shape long-term strategy, influence investment decisions, and ensure our roadmap is grounded in rigorous, scalable measurement frameworks.

Our Data Team is dedicated to empowering top-quality decision-making. Do you want to know how? Visit our Tech Radar to learn about the technologies we use at Preply!

What you’ll be doing:


Build and own the analytical framework leadership uses to evaluate B2B trade-offs, and define the long-term measurement framework that identifies structural growth levers, not just incremental wins.
Lead retention and cohort analyses that answer specific open questions from B2B leadership, turning findings into concrete pricing, product, or lifecycle recommendations.
Own impact modeling and scenario analysis for major B2B product initiatives, feeding directly into quarterly and annual planning through forecasting, trade-off analysis, and risk assessment.
Own metric definitions and governance for B2B, including resolving conflicting definitions across teams and maintaining a single source of truth others are expected to use.
Design the experimentation and analytics agenda: what gets tested, how success is measured, and run the analysis that determines whether initiatives actually moved the needle.
Partner with Directors and VPs across product, ops, and engineering to shape B2B strategy, mentor senior analysts to raise the analytical bar, and occasionally extend that work beyond B2B when company-level questions require it.


What you need to succeed:


You can point to one or more specific decisions (a pricing change, a resourcing call, a roadmap cut) that happened because of your analysis, and one where your recommendation was rejected and you can explain why, in hindsight, that was right or wrong.
You've owned a metric or strategic framework other teams were required to use, and resolved a conflict between two teams who each wanted a different definition to win.
You understand subscription or marketplace economics well enough to build an LTV or cohort model from scratch, not just interpret one someone else built.
Fluent, independent SQL and Python. You are the person other analysts send their code to for review, not the person waiting on review.
You've said no to a stakeholder's request because it wasn't the right question, and you've been right to.
You've built a forecast or scenario model that a VP used to defend a bet to their own leadership.


Nice to have:


Background in B2B SaaS, enterprise or account-based business models.
Experience building or scaling an analytics function (hiring, tooling, process, KPI frameworks…)
Experience with Tableau, Looker, or Power BI.
Master's or PhD in a quantitative field.


Why you’ll love it at Preply:


An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub
Access to free mental health support platforms;
Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;
The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).


Our Principles


Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.


Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Descripción de la empresa

MSX International es un líder global en servicios para el sector de automoción, presente en más de 80 países. Desde nuestra sede en Barcelona trabajamos con diferentes fabricantes internacionales para ofrecer soluciones innovadoras que impulsan la eficiencia, la calidad y el rendimiento de sus operaciones.

Si buscas un entorno dinámico, analítico, internacional y orientado a la mejora continua, este es tu sitio.

Descripción del empleo

Como Analista de Datos, serás responsable de gestionar, analizar y transformar datos clave relacionados con proyectos del sector automoción. Tu misión será convertir grandes volúmenes de datos en insights claros y accionables que apoyen la toma de decisiones, la optimización de procesos y el rendimiento general del negocio.

Requisitos


Realizar análisis diarios, semanales y mensuales utilizando herramientas como Tableau, Power BI y Excel
Identificar tendencias, variaciones y oportunidades de mejora
Preparar informes avanzados alineados con KPIs y requisitos del proyecto
Mantener, actualizar y asegurar la calidad de la documentación y reportes en herramientas como SharePoint y Office365
Identificar patrones en los datos y proponer acciones correctivas u oportunidades de optimización
Colaborar con equipos multifuncionales para convertir insights en acciones concretas
Garantizar el cumplimiento de estándares internos en informes y dashboards
Presentar análisis, conclusiones e información relevante a equipos internos y dirección
Asegurar la precisión, consistencia y calidad de los datos analizados
Proponer mejoras continuas en procesos, metodologías y flujos de análisis


Requisitos

Conocimientos y habilidades


Habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para trabajar con equipos diversos
Enfoque resolutivo para problemas complejos
Capacidad para gestionar prioridades y trabajar con plazos ajustados
Dominio de Tableau, Power BI y Excel
Conocimientos de sistemas de gestión de datos, minería de datos, procesos ETL y reporting automatizado
Competencias en análisis estadístico y modelos de rendimiento
Experiencia con herramientas de automatización (RPA) es un plus
Conocimiento de Microsoft Dynamics (deseable)


Formación


Grado en Ingeniería, Economía, Estadística, Matemáticas o formación equivalente


Experiencia


Experiencia previa demostrable como Analista de Datos


Idiomas


Español nativo
Inglés B2 (escrito y hablado)


Información adicional

Qué ofrecemos


Puesto permanente con contrato indefinido desde el primer día.
Política de teletrabajo de hasta el 50% de la jornada mensual tras el periodo de adaptación.
Formar parte de un gran equipo de profesionales en una compañía internacional consolidada.
Obtener una visión global del sector automoción, interactuando con clientes, proveedores, consultores y concesionarios.
Salario: 23.000 euros brutos anuales.
Acceso a MSX Bazaar, el portal de compras colectivas con grandes descuentos para empleados.
Posibilidad de adherirte al Plan de Retribución Flexible (seguro médico, tarjeta transporte, tarjeta restaurante, formación...).
23 días laborables de vacaciones al año según convenio y 3 días por año completo trabajado.
Incentivos adicionales por programas de recomendación interna, formadores internos, detección de nuevas oportunidades de negocio, etc.

Title: GESTOR/A DATA SCIENTIST MODELOS IA BCN/MAD
Description:
Descripción del puesto:

¿Qué proyectos desarrollamos?

 

El objetivo de esta convocatoria es cubrir una vacante de Gestor/a en 17509 – Modelos de gestión de riesgos. Las principales tareas que desarrolla el equipo del departamento son las siguientes: 

Análisis de datos para la toma de decisiones de gestión del riesgo de crédito.
Modelos de scoring y rating para la estimación del riesgo de crédito de las operaciones de activo. Modelos de seguimiento del riesgo, de identificación del deterioro y modelos para la gestión de recuperaciones y morosidad.
Análisis de nuevas metodologías, nuevas fuentes de datos y nuevas herramientas con el objetivo de mejorar las herramientas para la toma de decisiones de concesión y seguimiento del riesgo.
Dar soporte a los usuarios de los modelos y métricas de riesgo en los distintos ámbitos donde aplican. Análisis adhoc, seguimiento, consultas, soporte al buzón de Medidas de Riesgo.


El puesto de trabajo se encuentra en Servicios Centrales de Madrid o Barcelona.


Los proyectos que asumirás en la posición son:

Desarrollo y mantenimiento de los modelos de IA para sus distintos usos de calificación crediticia para cubrir todo el ciclo de vida del crédito (preconcesión, admisión, seguimiento, alertas, gestión preventiva, y recuperaciones y morosidad) y para todas las carteras (particulares, autónomos, empresas).
Seguimiento y monitorización de modelos de riesgo.
Definición de requerimientos de implantación de variables y modelos.
Soporte a las áreas de negocio en el uso de los modelos internos de medición de riesgo de crédito: identificación de las necesidades, obtención de datos, análisis y conclusiones.
Proyectos de analytics y modelización para la mejora de los procesos de gestión de riesgos.
Análisis de nuevas fuentes de información, nuevas metodologías avanzadas de modelización, nuevas herramientas para la explotación de datos y construcción de modelos.
Identificación de áreas con potenciales mejoras en los procesos y herramientas de modelización.
Análisis de herramientas externas para la mejora de los procesos de gestión de riesgos.
Soporte a los entornos de control en el desarrollo de sus funciones.
Participación en proyectos transversales para acelerar la transformación digital y la IA Generativa.


Descripción del perfil:

Requisitos mínimos

 

Licenciatura/Ingeniería/Máster universitario con perfil cuantitativo y de explotación de bases de datos (Matemáticas, Física, Económicas, Estadística, Telecomunicación, Informática, Data Science).
Dominio y utilización a nivel avanzado de herramientas de análisis y tratamiento de datos (Python y SQL).
Experiencia en construcción de modelos basados en metodologías avanzadas de aprendizaje automatizado (machine learning) y en la gestión de grandes volúmenes de datos.
Nivel elevado de inglés.

 

 

REQUISITOS ADICIONALES:

Conocimientos de herramientas de Google Cloud Platform (GCP), a destacar BigQuery y VertexIA.
Conocimientos del lenguaje de programación estadístico R
Conocimientos de IA Generativa, tanto de productividad personal como de desarrollo de soluciones para otras funciones.
Competencias Clave

 

Actitud resolutiva. Capacidad de dar respuesta a las peticiones de información en un corto periodo de tiempo.
Orientación a resultados y autonomía en el desarrollo de las tareas asignadas.
Capacidad de análisis, habilidades relacionales, proactividad y motivación para el trabajo en equipo.
Habilidades comunicativas para la interlocución con otros departamentos y el grupo.


Ofrecemos:



 

Formar parte del Banco más innovador en Europa Occidental, según los premios The Innovators de la revista estadounidense Global Finance.
Programa de onboarding y acompañamiento personalizado para tu desarrollo profesional.  
Itinerario formativo individual con acceso a nuestra plataforma online, que ofrece un extenso catálogo de recursos de autoaprendizaje para fomentar tu crecimiento continuo.
Dispondrás de un seguro de salud completo totalmente gratuito para ti. Además, quedarás adherido al Plan de Pensiones, al que CaixaBank realizará aportaciones pensando ya en tu futuro.
Retribución flexible aplicada a transporte, formación, idiomas, guardería, entre otros.
Medidas de flexibilidad (trabajo en remoto, flexibilidad entrada)
Contamos con la certificación Top Employer, que nos reconoce como una de las mejores empresas para trabajar

Title: Product Data Analyst | EU based/Remote
Description:
Join Hostinger, and we’ll grow fast! 🚀

We’re shaping the future of online success - powered by AI and driven by people. With 900+ talented professionals and over 5 million clients in 150 countries, we help creators and entrepreneurs bring their ideas to life faster and easier than ever before.

Our mission: To provide tools that help individuals and small businesses succeed online faster and easier.

Our culture: Guided by 10 company principles.

Our formula for success: Customer obsession, innovative products, and talented teams.

Your day-to-day:


Partner with Product teams to tackle challenges, reveal untapped potential, challenge status-quo and empower data-driven choices.
Use Amplitude to analyse user journeys and conduct A/B tests.
Use SQL and Tableau to extract and analyze data.
Build dashboards that make an impact - create powerful visualizations that give teams at Hostinger the visibility and confidence to take action, while ensuring data integrity and validity.
Use Lumos - our internal AI data agent to surface new insights and business recommendations.
Collaborate with our top-notch Data Platform team - work closely with data engineers and analytics engineers to ensure data availability, efficient processes and successful project execution.


Real projects you might work on:


Analysing AI-Powered Marketing Tool Users - our AI-powered Reach Team needs to understand product usage, user segments and conversions. Your insights could help us refine our approach and shape the future of Hostinger's Reach product. If you want to go the extra mile - some product-related user flow analysis and A/B testing would be welcome too!
Decoding AI WebMail Clients Engagement - our Mail Team is rapidly evolving the communication experience, and they require deep analytical support to fuel their growth. You will dive into customer behavior patterns, providing the strategic clarity needed to shape the next generation of Hostinger’s email solutions through data-backed innovation.
Optimizing Our Client Referral Program - As this initiative scales rapidly, your data-driven expertise will be essential in refining our commission frameworks. You will help us architect high-impact partnership strategies, ensuring we build deeper, more rewarding connections with our global client base.
Empowering Our Innovation Team - Innovation is at the core of our success. As we explore diverse new ventures, your analytical expertise will be vital in enriching these ideas with data. You will provide strategic guidance to Product Managers on whether and how to scale emerging business opportunities effectively.
Defining Product Adoption Success - We want to ensure our clients navigate our tools seamlessly and reach their objectives with ease. You will dive deep into product usage patterns and customer behavior, providing strategic recommendations to elevate the overall Hostinger experience through data-driven improvements.
And many more, depending on your skills, interests and business needs.


Your skills and experience:


2+ years of experience in a product analyst, data analyst, business analyst or similar role.
Experience with A/B testing and user journey analysis.
Hands-on SQL expertise - you can write queries, create and optimize dashboard models. Basically, Claude asks you to check queries.
Proficiency in data visualization tools - we use Tableau, but experience with other tools works too.
A results-driven mindset - you love turning raw data into clear, actionable insights that drive business impact.
Strong communication & collaboration skills - you can explain complex data in a simple way and work well with cross-functional teams.
Bonus: Experience with Amplitude or other product analytics tools.
Extra points for: experience with Python or R for data analysis, A/B testing experience or knowledge of statistical concepts.


Benefits for you:

🚀 360 Growth: We provide limitless learning opportunities: access to platforms like Reforge and CoachHub, global conferences, feedback culture, digital libraries, and industry-leading subscriptions. Advance your career with internal mobility, and grow with a team eager to share knowledge and support your success.

🎯 Freedom & responsibility: Work on your terms, whether from the comfort of home or anywhere in the world. With a home office budget, you can elevate your workspace. Enjoy the flexibility to manage your schedule while bringing your ideas to life in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

💪 Wellness simplified: Your health comes first with company-provided sick days, 20 paid suspension days, Headspace subscriptions, and recharge leave. Participate in wellbeing-dedicated events and simply enjoy the balance of a lifestyle that prioritizes wellness.

🎉 Work hard - party hard: Recognize hard work with company events like Town Hall, Meet the Client initiatives, team-building experiences, and workations. Celebrate life’s big moments with milestone gifts for weddings, new parenthood, and graduations.

Compensation:

We’re looking for people who can make a meaningful impact, and we recognize that different levels of experience bring different levels of value. Compensation for this role will be discussed throughout the hiring process and tailored based on your skills, experience, and potential contribution to the team.

Get ready to take your personal and professional growth to new heights! Join Hostinger today and be part of our journey 🚀

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About Thunes

Thunes is the Smart Superhighway for money movement around the world. Thunes’ proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real-time in over 140 countries and more than 90 currencies. Thunes’ Network connects directly to over 12 billion mobile wallets and bank accounts worldwide, via more than 350 different payment methods, such as GCash, M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more.

Thunes’ Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in-house Smart Treasury Management Platform and Fortress Compliance Infrastructure, ensuring Members of the Network receive unrivalled speed, control, visibility, protection, and cost efficiencies when making real-time payments globally. Members of Thunes’ Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks.

Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 15 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, London, Manila, Nairobi, Paris, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Miami, Johannesburg, Riyadh, San Francisco and Atlanta For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com/

Context of the 12-months role

We are looking for a driven and product-minded BI Analyst who combines strong analytical skills with a genuine interest in solving real business problems through data.

In this role, you will turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that support better decision-making across the business. You will help identify product and operational pain points, improve day-to-day insight consumption for internal teams, and contribute to a strong data informed culture across the company.

You will work closely with data engineers to design, build, and maintain analytical solutions for key internal stakeholders across different functions, that improves our productivity, business performance, and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand reporting, analysis, and insight needs, and translate them into effective analytical solutions.
Build a strong understanding of key business processes, product flows, operational challenges, and performance metrics.
Design, develop, and maintain production-grade dashboards, reports, and analytical assets using Tableau and other relevant tools.
Write production-level SQL and Python to support analytics, reporting, data transformation, and scalable insight delivery.
Work closely with data engineering teams to ensure data sources are reliable, well-structured, and fit for analytical use.
Contribute to improving reporting standards, data definitions, and analytical best practices within the team.
Manage priorities effectively across requests, aligned with team direction and company priorities.



Professional Experience And Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or another quantitative field.
2-5 years of experience in a data, BI, analytics, or related role.
Strong hands-on experience writing production-level SQL.
Strong hands-on experience using Python for analysis, data processing, and analytical solution development.
Strong expertise in Tableau, including dashboard development, data source design, performance optimisation, and Tableau Online administration and management.

Title: Fraud Data Analyst
Description:
About Us

Satispay began by rethinking the simple act of a payment to remove the friction from our daily routines. But we didn't stop there. Today, we are building a complete financial platform designed to empower people and concretely improve their lives.

By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need.

What You'll Be Doing

As our Fraud Data Analyst, you'll be the person who secures the future of digital payments by architecting sophisticated real-time defense strategies.

Here's What Your Day-to-day Will Look Like


Architect Real-Time Strategies – You will be responsible for our real-time decisioning engine, designing and deploying logic that combines ML scores with velocity features to make millisecond decisions.
Precision Rule Development – Translate complex fraud patterns into high-performing rules, optimizing the balance between False Positive Rates (FPR) and Gross Fraud Loss.
Deconstruct Payment Fraud – Proactively hunt for emerging schemes (ATO, social engineering) and turn these insights into end-to-end mitigation strategies.
Optimize the Decisioning Stack – Partner with Product and Engineering to define analytical requirements for new features and third-party data signals.
Calibrate ML & Heuristics – Work with Data Science to operationalize machine learning models, determining how to best "wrap" model scores with heuristic rules.
Champion Frictionless UX – Analyze security measures to identify unnecessary hurdles, designing dynamic friction strategies for a seamless user experience.
Strategic Performance Reporting – Monitor rule efficacy and portfolio health, presenting data-driven recommendations to senior leadership to evolve our risk appetite.


Expect challenges, collaboration, and the freedom to bring your ideas to life in a fast-moving and supportive environment. Things change quickly here, so be ready to adapt, take initiative, and shape your role as we grow.

Who We're Looking For

We need a problem-solver who loves teamwork and gets things done. If you're curious and ready for real ownership, you'll fit in! Does this sound like you?


Experience – You have between 3 and 7 years of professional experience, specifically within the risk, payments, or credit sectors.
Technical Proficiency – You are highly skilled in SQL and Python for data analysis and strategy development.
Domain Expertise – You have a solid understanding of payment fraud dynamics and experience working with real-time decisioning environments.
Communication – You possess excellent communication skills and are fluent in English.
Nice to Have – Experience with Machine Learning, Data Science, PySpark, or GraphQL knowledge is a significant plus.

Title: Data & Yield Analyst
Description:
About Softonic

At Softonic, people come first. We’re a multicultural team passionate about building digital experiences used by millions of users worldwide. Guided by a fail fast, learn faster mindset, we encourage curiosity, experimentation, and continuous improvement, to make a real impact.

Our culture is shaped by four principles:


Step up: Take ownership and act with integrity.
Work smart: Focus on impact and efficiency.
One team: Collaborate openly and support each other.
Think big: Stay curious and challenge the status quo.


Team up with us to grow your career in an international, collaborative, and people-focused company where your ideas matter and your work reaches a global audience.

About The Role

We are a global premium publisher with 28 years of history, providing quality software & APPs download services across multiple languages, also expanding with white labels (Download.com Filehippo), Publisher network (rev.amp), and more partnerships on the way.

As our data & yield analyst reporting to the Director of Advertising, you will be responsible for bridging all revenue team’s data-analytics need (including but not limited to datasets, data visualization, and automation with the process for revenue generation/optimization purposes) with our BI team, to drive initiatives that will boost making more & better data-driven decisions and improve efficiency on revenue generation. Will also take the yield function to analyze market trends & discover business opportunities, not only providing insights to the relevant teams (Sales, Paid, Partnership, Adtech, Product, Traffic, etc) but also following through with the implementation of the initiatives to ensure the business impact is realized.

Key Responsibilities


Be a data champion inside the Advertising & RevOps team and the go-to-person for ithe team & stakeholders from other revenue teams when it comes to better utilization of our data.
Help revenue teams to identify opportunities: using new data points, visualization and automation solutions and ideas to improve revenue generation efficiency, take those requirements, coordinate with dev (BI or other teams) to build the roadmap for the projects & implement accordingly.
Oversee & analyze mid-long (monthly, quarterly, YoY) term yield performance/trends of revenue streams & devices, provide insights on fluctuation, alerts when needed, and recommend a clear plan of action.
Provide A/B test or lean test analysis with recommendations for revenue-related initiatives.
Manage UPR optimisation and automation of pricing recommendation tool (either 3rd party or in-house).
Be able to use agentic AI tools to automate process & streamline data processing & analytic flows to deliver results efficiently
Provide insights on market trends, opportunities, and inventory availability information to the sales & AMs team for better usage of market data
Help teams turn data into actionable insights that unlock revenue opportunities and support smarter business decisions.


Must have


At least 2 years of working experience working as business analyst, preferably with experience in digital advertising business.
Experience of working with BI platforms, like Tableau, Qlikview & advance skills of Google Analytics.
Experience of doing data analysis work with AI tools like Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, Copilot, etc.
Experience of working with BigQuery, SQL & Python.
Preferable background on big data, data science related topics.
Experience building analytical models and working with structured and unstructured data sets to drive business decisions.
Knowledge of the online advertising ecosystem.
Basic understanding of budgeting, financial forecast, and accounting principles is preferred.
Excellent communication and project management skills with a strong business acumen.
Ability to work on own initiative in a fast-moving environment.
High level of motivation, determination and commitment.
An excellent command of both written and spoken English is required.


Why Softonic?


Private Health Care
Hybrid Work Model (3 days on-site per week in Poblenou area)
Flexible remote work options during certain periods of the year
Flexible Spending Plan & Free Tax Consultant
Learning & Development: Language Classes (English, Spanish, Catalan) and Training Program
Workplace Amenities: Dining Room, Gaming Room, Terraces, and complimentary fresh fruit, coffee, snacks, and drinks
Team & Social Events: Pizza & Beers every Thursday
Lifestyle Benefits: Discounts at gyms and restaurants
Additional Time Off: Birthday leave
Opt for: Mac or Windows laptop
Wellhub program

Title: Revenue Management Analyst
Description:
Overview

Revenue Management Analyst

Design and implement the Pack, Price and Promotion Strategy across the different channels, with the objective of maximizing PepsiCo’s Net Revenue & Profitability.

This role sits at the intersection of consumer & commercial strategy, and financial performance, ensuring the right value propositions reach the right consumers, through the right channels, at the right price and in the right formats, while balancing profitability, competitiveness, and customer needs.

This role must have close collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Category teams to drive sustainable growth through data-driven decision-making.

Responsibilities

Main Accountabilities:


Design and recommend Pack & Price strategies across brands and different sub-channels, grounded in insights and performance analysis
Lead Promotional strategy definition and implementation. Define the annual promo calendar, based on shopper insights to maximize performance. Perform periodic analysis to understand results & tailor the strategy.
Drive mix development initiatives to maximize Net Revenue Realization (NRR), acting as a category-wide owner of mix levers across channels and departments.
Own PPA initiatives, working together with sales, marketing & commercialization, ensuring market-fit and strategic relevance.
Lead the AOP strategy & algorithm, aligning short- and long-term initiatives to deliver volume, revenue, and profitability targets.
Create x-channel commercial policy, and define list prices for all SKUs, participating in the innovation gates.
Partner with Sales to co-create commercially sound proposals, including multipacks , bonuspacks or I&Os in order to boost volumes.
Support the implementation & adoption RGM Digital tools (e.g. elasticity, ROI, Uplift models…)
Anticipate proactively the market changes, for analysis and decision making (VAT or Tax impacts, legislations, sustainability goals..etc)
Monitor and track implemented initiatives in order to obtain learnings & insights to optimize and define future strategies.
Ensure cross-functional alignment across Sales, Trade Marketing, Insights, Finance, Marketing, Category Management, and Commercialization.


Qualifications

Experience required


At least 7 years experience in Revenue Management, Finance Planning, Insights, Commercial roles or similar.
Experience in the use of internal & external data bases (Nielsen, SAP,…)
Knowledge of RGM & finance KPIs (NR, MC, Elasticity, ROI..) preferred
Proactivity, ability to work in a cross functional environment and with collaboration spirit
Strong Microsoft Office skills (Excel and ppt)
Fluent in Spanish and English (advanced level)


Competencies Required


Good story telling and communication skills
Very strong analytical skills & high business knowledge as a broad perspective is needed to identify channel opportunities
Strategic thinking. Ability to see connection in data, anticipate potential risks/opportunities, and optimize & simplify processes.
Self-driven, able to work independently and take initiative
Team player & Proactive collaboration
Resilience and adaptability to change
Capacity to work under pressure and tight deadlines
Experience in stakeholder management


Why PepsiCo Iberia?

PepsiCo Iberia, part of the Western Europe Operating Unit, is home to a team of nearly 3,000 talented employees across our Barcelona, Madrid, Vitoria and Lisbon headquarters, and our production sites in Spain and Portugal.

With iconic brands like Pepsi, 7UP, Alvalle, Lay’s or Doritos, we continue to shape the food and beverage landscape as one of the region’s leading companies.

At PepsiCo, you’re not just joining a business - you’re joining a culture that champions innovation, encourages bold thinking and empowers every individual to make an impact.

Title: GESTOR/A DE LA OFICINA DE PLANES DE RECUPERACIÓN Y RESOLUCIÓN (BCN/MAD)
Description:
Descripción del puesto:



La misión de la Oficina de planes de recuperación y resolución (en adelante, ORR) es coordinar e implementar los requerimientos de dos autoridades europeas:

el Banco Central Europeo, en referencia al Plan de Recuperación.
la Junta Única de Resolución (SRB, Single Resolution Board) en referencia a la planificación de la resolución.

El objetivo último es asegurar que la entidad sea más más resiliente ante posibles crisis. Para ello, desde la ORR se desarrollan proyectos transversales que implican a numerosos departamentos de la entidad y filiales del Grupo. 

Dichas autoridades europeas han incrementado los requerimientos de información en los últimos años y, en este contexto, la persona que se incorpore estará involucrada en las siguientes tareas:

Soporte en la elaboración del reporting periódico de resolución, aportando valor añadido mediante la optimización continua de los procesos asociados.
Apoyo en la coordinación y gestión de los diversos proyectos que se desarrollan en el área para dar respuesta a los requerimientos de las autoridades.
Soporte en la elaboración de los entregables que se remiten a dichas autoridades.
Colaborar en la preparación del material necesario sobre el punto de situación y grado de avance de los proyectos, para compartir con los órganos de gestión y de gobierno, y específicamente con el Comité de Planes de Recuperación y Resolución.

 El equipo de ORR está repartido entre las oficinas de Barcelona (Avda. Diagonal) y Madrid (Paseo de la Castellana).



Descripción del perfil:


Perfil data scientist y/o data engineer con titulación superior en Economía, ADE o ingenierías.
Imprescindible alto nivel de inglés escrito y hablado. Con capacidad para:
Redactar entregables íntegramente en inglés.
Comprensión escrita para interpretar sin dificultades documentos de los supervisores con requerimientos y guías detalladas.
Se valorará el conocimiento del negocio y la organización de CaixaBank.
Necesario el conocimiento y haber trabajado con herramientas ofimáticas (Powerpoint, Word, Excel).
Conocimiento de herramientas para la preparación, análisis y la explotación de datos (SAS, SQL o similares, QlikSense, Python, Suite de Google Cloud Platform).

Competencias clave

Actitud proactiva y capacidad de trabajo en equipo y de forma transversal.
Capacidad de relación y comunicación, para interactuar con diferentes áreas de la entidad.
Capacidad de priorización y paralelización de varios proyectos, con calendarios ajustados.
Resiliencia y capacidad de adaptación a entornos cambiantes. 


Ofrecemos:


Formar parte del Banco más innovador en Europa Occidental, según los premios The Innovators de la revista estadounidense Global Finance.
Programa de onboarding y acompañamiento personalizado para tu desarrollo profesional.  
Itinerario formativo individual con acceso a nuestra plataforma online, que ofrece un extenso catálogo de recursos de autoaprendizaje para fomentar tu crecimiento continuo.
Dispondrás de un seguro de salud completo totalmente gratuito para ti. Además, quedarás adherido al Plan de Pensiones, al que CaixaBank realizará aportaciones pensando ya en tu futuro.
Retribución flexible aplicada a transporte, formación, idiomas, guardería, entre otros.
Medidas de flexibilidad (trabajo en remoto, flexibilidad entrada)
Contamos con la certificación Top Employer, que nos reconoce como una de las mejores empresas para trabajar

Title: Senior Data & BI Business Analyst (Industrial / Supply Chain)
Description:
Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.

We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.

We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.

Role

As a Senior Data & BI Business Analyst (Industrial / Supply Chain), you will be:


Understanding Industrial / Supply Chain business challenges and translating them into structured functional requirements
Gathering, analysing, and prioritising requirements through stakeholder workshops, and producing detailed functional specifications for BI & Analytics solutions
Defining data models and business objects with Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers, applying dimensional modeling (star schema, facts, dimensions, KPIs, semantic models)
Supporting UAT, validation, and ensuring business requirements are met throughout delivery
Upholding data governance, business rules, documentation, and data-quality standards, and driving user adoption of BI/Data best practices


Requirements

To succeed in this role, you bring a combination of expertise, experience, and skills including:


6+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or Business Analysis. The ideal candidate now has a role of Project Manager / Delivery Coordinator.
Experience on Industrial / Supply Chain / Manufacturing projects is a must.
Experience with modern analytics platforms such as Power BI, Databricks, dbt, or cloud data platforms
Good understanding of dimensional data modeling and BI semantic models / analytical reporting platforms
Fluent French (mandatory) and a good professional level of English
Based in or able to work on-site in Barcelona from the beginning of September
Nice to have: experience in the watchmaking / luxury manufacturing industry


Benefits

Benefits

What we offer


A competitive compensation package
A yearly education budget to steep your learning curve
A yearly sport budget because a fit body leads to a fit mind
A flexible working culture because your work-life balance matters to us
An international, knowledgeable, and passionate team with a strong collaborative mindset


Check our LinkedIn and website to learn more about us & don't hesitate to contact us if you have any questions.

Title: Senior Data Analyst, DTC (Consumer & Ecommerce Analytics)
Description:
Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We’re a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.

At Levi Strauss & Co, we are revolutionizing the apparel business and redefining the way denim is made.

We are taking one of the world's most iconic brands into the next century: from creating machine learning-powered denim finishes to using block-chain for our factory workers' wellbeing, to building algorithms to better meet the needs of our consumers and optimize our supply chain.

Be a pioneer in the fashion industry by joining our global Data, Analytics & AI "startup with assets," where you will have the chance to build exciting solutions that will impact our global business across continents.

As a Senior Data Analyst you will be a senior individual contributor within the global Data, Analytics and AI team, turning ecommerce and consumer data into trusted, decision-ready insight for stakeholders across regions. You will own the definition, build-out, and governance of key metrics and dashboards — partnering with Product, Marketing, Finance, and Regional teams to make sure the business is steering on numbers it can trust. This role sits at the center of our analytics foundations: our data platform as the single source of truth, and the emerging semantic layer.

In this role you will move fluently between SQL, the data warehouse, and visualization tools to answer business questions, build self-service products, and certify the definitions that everyone else consumes. You will raise the bar on data quality, consistency, and storytelling — and help establish the global-with-regional-voice governance model that lets local markets move fast without fragmenting the truth.

You will be expected to mentor junior analysts, establish best practices, and contribute to the global Data, Analytics & AI community by sharing your knowledge and designing scalable, global solutions.

About The Job


Own key analytics workstreams end-to-end — from business question and metric definition through certified dashboard and adoption — partnering with stakeholders across the global organization.
Define, certify, and govern metrics in the semantic layer and ARC, ensuring a single, consistent source of truth across ecommerce, consumer, and loyalty reporting.
Build and maintain production-grade dashboards and data products (Looker, Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar) that drive self-service and reduce ad-hoc reporting load.
Write complex, performant SQL against large datasets in BigQuery; build and maintain transformation pipelines (dbt) feeding the analytics layer.
Act as the primary analytics point of contact for assigned business stakeholders — translating ambiguous business problems into clear analyses and communicating results to non-technical audiences with compelling data storytelling.
Conduct deep-dive analyses (cohorting, funnel, CLV, retention, promo/discount, demand) to surface trends, quantify impact, and recommend action.
Support experimentation and measurement — partnering on A/B test readouts, KPI alignment, and incrementality framing.
Define and enforce best practices for metric documentation, dashboard standards, QA, and data validation within the team.
Mentor and coach junior analysts, providing guidance on SQL, visualization, business framing, and career development.
Drive global–regional analytics governance — aligning global frameworks with local market needs so regions get the nuance they need without forking definitions.
Proactively identify data-quality, consistency, and readiness gaps, and partner with Data Engineering / Platform to close them.
Ensure risks associated with deliverables are raised and mitigated to keep workstreams on track.


About You

Required Technical Skills:


5+ years of hands-on experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a closely related field, delivering insight that changed business decisions.
5+ years writing complex SQL against large datasets in cloud-based environments; hands-on experience with BigQuery (or equivalent) and ideally dbt.
5+ years with data visualization / BI tools (Looker / LookML, Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar); able to choose the right visualization for the data and build compelling narratives.
Strong grounding in metric definition and governance — building certified, reusable definitions rather than one-off reports; semantic-layer experience a strong plus.
Solid analytical/statistical foundation — cohorting, segmentation, funnel analysis, retention/CLV, and a working understanding of experimentation (A/B testing, incrementality).
Comfort with Python (or R) for analysis and automation.
Experience with cloud data platforms, with a focus on Google Cloud Platform a plus.
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills; able to operate across regions and functions (Product, Marketing, Finance).
Demonstrated experience mentoring junior analysts and establishing team standards.


Desired Education And Experience


Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative discipline (statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, data science, or related).
Overall 5+ years of professional experience in analytics / business intelligence, ideally in retail, ecommerce, or consumer-facing industries.
Track record of delivering analytics products (dashboards, definitions, deep dives) that drove measurable business impact (revenue, cost savings, decision quality).
Prior experience as a senior individual contributor, with evidence of influencing team practices and stakeholder decisions.


The expected starting salary range for this role is €60,500 – €80,700 Gross per year. The amount an employee will earn within the salary range will be based on factors such as relevant education, qualifications, performance, and our needs. Salary ranges may vary by location and currency. Where roles are advertised across multiple locations, local ranges will apply.

Title: Data Modeller & Financial Analyst
Description:
Data Modeller & Financial Analyst | Gibraltar | On-site

BVGroup brings over 80 years of expertise to every bet, delivering technology-driven betting and gaming experiences to a global audience.

BetVictor is our flagship B2C brand, complemented by multiple partner brands we manage and service such as Heart Bingo, talkSPORT BET to name but a few. Our SaaS platform is fully developed and ready to deploy, requiring minimal setup and no complex configuration.

Join us at BVGroup and make an impact in a fast-paced, global industry. Collaborate with passionate experts, tackle exciting challenges, and help define the next generation of online sports betting and gaming.

Purpose Of The Role

As a Financial Modeller & Planning Analyst, you will report to the Director of Financial Planning & Analysis and play a key role in supporting the Group’s financial planning, forecasting, reporting and system enhancement initiatives.

You will be responsible for developing and maintaining financial models in Excel and Oracle NSPB, supporting management reporting, budgeting and forecasting processes, as well as delivering insightful analysis to business stakeholders. In addition, you will act as a key driver of planning system improvements, working closely with internal teams and third-party providers to continuously enhance planning and reporting capabilities across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities


Developing, maintaining and enhancing financial models to support annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, monthly reporting and variance analysis.
Partnering with budget owners and business stakeholders to build robust, data-driven financial models using historical performance and operational metrics.
Delivering scenario, sensitivity and ad-hoc financial analysis to support business planning and strategic decision-making.
Ensuring the accuracy, integrity and continuous improvement of financial models, reporting outputs and forecasting methodologies.
Producing monthly management reporting and providing meaningful financial insights to stakeholders across the business.
Analysing, reconciling and managing financial data across multiple systems to improve reporting quality and forecasting accuracy.
Identifying and implementing process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of FP&A activities.
Leading and coordinating planning system projects, including the implementation, enhancement and ongoing optimisation of Oracle NSPB and related planning tools.
Acting as the primary liaison between internal stakeholders, third-party providers, Business Intelligence and Technology teams to drive planning and reporting enhancements.
Supporting the ongoing maintenance, development, user adoption and continuous improvement of planning models, reporting frameworks and system capabilities.


Requirements


Advanced Excel skills, including financial modelling, complex formulas, pivot tables, dashboards, charts and macros.
Previous experience with financial accounting principles and KPI’s, financial modelling, budgeting, forecasting or on a similar analytical finance role.
Experience using financial planning and reporting systems, preferably Oracle NSPB or equivalent EPM solutions.
Demonstrated project management skills with the ability to coordinate stakeholders and deliver initiatives successfully.
Proven ability to build and maintain scalable, transparent and user-friendly financial models from the ground up.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into meaningful business insights and recommendations.
Experience within the online gaming, betting or wider digital entertainment industry is desirable.
Highly proactive, self-motivated and detail-oriented, with excellent organisational and communication skills, combined with a professional approach to confidentiality and ethical conduct.


How We Hire

Our interviews are a two-way process, and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational, and we want to get the best from you, so come at us with questions and be curious.

In the event that we receive sufficient applications for the role this vacancy may be subject to early closure. Therefore, if you are interested, please submit your application as early as possible.

Title: Data Analyst Intern
Description:
Overview

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

Responsibilities

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Customer Master Data & Business Analyst Intern to join our team in Barcelona. This internship offers hands-on experience working with business data, customer data management, reporting, pricing analytics, process improvement, and data-driven decision-making while collaborating with cross-functional teams across a global organization.

Key Responsibilities


Assist in collecting, cleaning, validating, and maintaining customer and business data from multiple sources.
Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, business insights, and opportunities for process improvement.
Create dashboards, reports, KPIs, and data visualizations for internal stakeholders and business leaders.
Support ongoing analytics, reporting, pricing, and customer master data projects, as well as ad-hoc data requests.
Help automate recurring reports and improve data management and business processes.
Support quotation analysis, reporting activities, and approval workflows.
Collaborate with global teams to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and operational efficiency.
Document methodologies, business processes, assumptions, and data definitions.


Qualifications

Must Have


Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field, with the ability to sign a full-time 12-month internship agreement through the university.
Basic knowledge of data analysis concepts, reporting, and statistical methods.
Experience with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and a structured approach to work.
Strong communication skills in English.
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative and international environment.


Nice to Have


Experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker).
Basic knowledge of databases, SQL, and data modeling.
Experience creating reports, dashboards, or KPI tracking.
Interest in customer data management, pricing, business operations, or process improvement.

Contribuir a benchmarks, análisis sectoriales y revisión de buenas prácticas.
Participar en reuniones y dinámicas de trabajo con equipos internos y clientes.
Aplicar pensamiento crítico para proponer soluciones pragmáticas y de valor.

Excel avanzado y manejo sólido de datos.
Dominio de Power BI, Tableau o herramientas equivalentes de visualización.
Conocimiento o interés por marcos y métricas de sostenibilidad/ESG.
Capacidad para trabajar con grandes volúmenes de información y evidencias.

Institució

Investigador/s Responsable/s Del Projecte

Maria Del Mar Albà Soler

Deciphering de novo gene birth in populations (101052538)

Grup de recerca en genòmica evolutiva

Descripció

La persona seleccionada s'incorporarà al Grup de recerca en genòmica evolutiva (Programa de recerca en informàtica biomèdica).

Suport en el desenvolupament de models d'aprenentatge automàtic o d'intel.ligència artifical per predir la traducció de pautes de lectura no canòniques (ncORFs) localitzades en transcrits celulars. Determinació de la precisió dels models utilitzant diferent mètriques tals com "Balanced accuracy", ROC-AUC o Macro-F1. Identificació de característiques de seqüència associades amb la traducció de ncORFs. Refinament dels models mitjançant la inclusió de variables addicionals. Confecció d'informes de la feina desenvolupada i els resultats obtinguts. Producció de imatges d'alta qualitat per la seva publicació.

Experiència a nivell de projecte de màster d'un mínim de 6 mesos.

Coneixements

Coneixement de models d'aprenentatge automàtic i intel.ligència artificial. Abilitat per treballar amb grans quantitats de dades de seqüencies de ARN. Comprensió dels procesos que governen la traducció del ARN en proteïnes. Domini del anglès tant parlat com escrit.

Aquest contracte és part d’un projecte que ha rebut finançament del programa de recerca i innovació Horitzó 2020 de la Unió Europea dins de l’acord de subvenció Nº 101052538.

Description:
About The Team

Kiloverse is the operational force that helps ventures grow — building the systems, teams, and infrastructure that turn ideas into scalable businesses. Behind every fast-growing product, there’s a group of people who think like owners, act fast, and execute with precision.

Here, you’ll find people who want to break big in their careers — working side by side with entrepreneurs and founders to build ventures that redefine the health, wellness, beauty, or travel industries.

Data team, as part of Kiloverse, the operational force behind every impactful Kilo solution, provides advanced data engineering, modelling and reporting solutions for the whole group.

Currently, we are looking for an experienced data analyst to work on internal media buying tool that will help scale the business even further.

Get ready to


Identify, investigate and solve data issues: data quality, data discrepancies, missing data
Contribute to the development and improvement of data solutions
Leverage the power of dbt for overcoming complex modelling problems with a focus on performance, robustness and scalability
Employ GCP tools (dbt, Airflow and Looker) to enhance data quality, efficiency, and delivery of accurate and timely data
Work on prevention and alerting solutions
Adopt and refine our best practices e.g. naming convention, data modeling, and data quality testing
Communicate with cross-functional teams and non-technical stakeholders in a clear and structured manner
Assist and support other team members in the design, development, and implementation of data warehousing, reporting, and analytics solutions
Take ownership of tasks and initiatives


We expect you to


Have at least 4 years of proven SQL skills: ability to join and manipulate data of various types (String, Integer, JSON, Array), write parameterized scripts, debug SQL code
Experience working with dbt is a plus
Experience with analytics tracking tools (e.g., Snowplow, GA4) is a strong plus
Know ETL and warehousing concepts
Have strong communication skills: timely, clear, and consistent sharing of information, work progress, bottlenecks and findings
Have curious and growth-oriented mindset towards constant learning
Be capable to understand, tackle, and communicate problems from both technical and business perspectives
Be fluent in English.


Salary

Gross salary range is 3000-4000 EUR/month.

Location

Choose between our Vilnius headquarters or our Kaunas hub — two great spaces designed for doing your best work.

For Vilnius: 4 days onsite, 1 flexible day remote. Meanwhile, in Kaunas: onsite, hybrid, or remote options are available depending on the role.

Speaking of perks:

Own your wellness

7 extra days off, 3 for weddings, hybrid work, and the freedom to work 2 months from anywhere in the world.

Shape your growth path

Builders never stop learning. Coaching, mentorship, training, conferences, online courses, subscriptions, books – you’ve got a €1100 yearly budget to fuel personal or team growth. You pick the path – we’ll back you all the way.

Drive global impact

This is where ambition scales. Build impact across 30+ brands worldwide. Launch bold projects. Even step in as a co-founder – we reward those who push further. And if you bring in more great people, you get €1500 for every successful referral.

Title: IT Support (Level 1)
Description:
About Olala!

Olala! is an international hospitality and real estate group, developing, owning, and operating hotels, vacation rentals, and food & beverage concepts worldwide.

Since 1996, we have built a presence in 17 cities worldwide, combining global expertise with local insight. Our mission is to deliver smart, technology-driven, and design-forward accommodations that meet the needs of today’s traveler while upholding the highest standards of service.

Your role

We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Level 1 IT Support to join our team.

As a Level 1 IT Support you will be in charge of assisting the group’s technical infrastructure.

This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the vacation rental industry and contribute to the growth of our company.

Your Journey


Provide first-level technical support (hardware, software, networks).
Assist users with productivity tools (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365), ERP and PMS platforms, and general SaaS tools used by the company.
Log and follow up on tickets via the company’s ticketing system (e.g. Asana/Jira).
Perform basic setup and maintenance of devices.
Escalate unresolved issues to Level 2 support when necessary.


What Do You Bring To Your Trip


Basic knowledge of operating systems (Windows, macOS).
Familiarity with networking fundamentals (Wi-Fi, LAN) and basic troubleshooting.
Experience with SaaS platforms and user administration.
Familiarity with ticketing systems.
Strong customer orientation and clear communication.
Proactive attitude and ability to follow support protocols.
Working proficiency in English (spoken and written).


Life at Olala!


Breakfast is the most important meal of the day. Fruit, coffee & milk is on us!
You will have access to apply for our private healthcare after a probation period of 6 or 12 months, depending on your type of contract.
Employees know it first! You will be able to enjoy an annual credit to use in one of our accommodations around the world.

Together we revolutionize the way people travel!

At Olala! we take pride in cultivating a vibrant and inclusive work environment that celebrates individuality and diversity. We believe that these are invaluable assets that fuel innovation, foster creativity and drive our overall success.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Title: Receptionist - Kings League
Description:
About The Kings League

Kings League is redefining sports and entertainment through an innovative digital-first model that combines competition, content, and community. With millions of fans across multiple markets, the league continues to expand its presence and cultural relevance globally.

About The Role

We are looking for a Receptionist to be the first point of contact for visitors, clients, and suppliers at our office. You will manage incoming and outgoing communications in person, by phone, and via email, while providing administrative support across a variety of day-to-day office operations.

Key Responsibilities

Reception & Guest Experience


Welcome visitors in a friendly, professional, and courteous manner.
Respond to enquiries and direct visitors to the appropriate person or department.
Handle incoming phone calls and relay messages accurately.
Maintain and update visitor records, including contact information


Mails and Deliveries


Receive, sort, and distribute incoming mail and packages.
Prepare and coordinate outgoing mail, documents, and shipments.


Administrative Support


Assist with the preparation and distribution of internal documents.
Coordinate meeting room bookings and manage meeting schedules when required.
Manage office supplies, including stationery, kitchen supplies, and other workplace essentials.
Coordinate catering services for meetings and company events.


Qualifications:


Vocational qualification or degree in Business Administration or a related field is preferred.
Previous experience in customer service, administration, or reception is considered an asset.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Catalan, Spanish, and English; additional languages are a plus.
Proficiency with telephone systems and standard office software (e.g., Microsoft Office or Google Workspace).


Diversity & Inclusion commitment

At Kings League, we strongly believe in building an inclusive and diverse work environment where everyone can develop their full potential. We are committed to integrating people of any profile, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, origin, or disability status, and fostering a team where everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow. If you meet the requirements for the position, we invite you to submit your application; we value the richness that diversity brings and look forward to welcoming your talent and experience.

Title: Direzione Sanitaria - Firenze
HTML:
🦷 Impress è stata fondata con la missione di combinare la salute orale e gli obiettivi estetici insieme ad un approccio medico orientato al cliente: la nostra mission è impegnarci a farti sorridere!

🩺🥼 Il nostro team di Ortodontisti esperti crea piani di trattamento personalizzati, da casi semplici a complessi. Investiamo nella tecnologia per rendere l'esperienza del cliente accessibile dando un follow-up comodo e anche a distanza.

Poiché Impress continua ad aumentare la sua portata globale, siamo alla ricerca di un/una persona che gestisca la Direzione Sanitaria per la clinica di Firenze che farà parte di un team laborioso e in rapida crescita. Si richiede disponibilitá secondo normativa locale vigente.

Responsabilità come dottore/essa e responsabile sanitario: 📝💪

  • Eseguire scansioni 3D o impronte dentali su pazienti per determinare il design dei prodotti ortodontici;
  • Rivedere le informazioni diagnostiche degli allineatori ortodontici per la completezza e l'accuratezza prima di inviarle al team medico di ortodontisti per lo sviluppo del piano di trattamento;
  • Fornire comunicazioni sui cambiamenti di protocollo e sulle informazioni rilevanti.
  • Fornire un feedback sulla qualità del caso;
  • Creare rapporti giornalieri, settimanali e mensili sullo stato di ammissibilità dei casi, stabilendo protocolli come guida per i dentisti;
  • Responsabilità generale igienica e organizzativa della struttura sanitaria per quanto riguarda utilizzo ottimale delle risorse strutturali, tecnologiche e di personale;
  • Adottare le misure necessarie per salvaguardare la salute degli operatori, dei pazienti e dei visitatori;
  • Assicurare la corretta compilazione della documentazione clinica;
  • Responsabile della corretta conservazione della documentazione sanitaria;
  • Raccordarsi con la ASL di competenza per la concreta attuazione delle iniziative di promozione della la prevenzione, l'educazione sanitaria e la tutela della salute;
  • Rivedere le informazioni diagnostiche degli allineatori ortodontici per la completezza e l'accuratezza prima di inviarle a un professionista dentale con licenza di rete per lo sviluppo del piano di trattamento;
  • Eseguire trattamenti al di fuori del contesto ortodontico dove si ha esperienza, l'azienda in ogni caso fornisce gli strumenti.
  • Creare rapporti giornalieri, settimanali e mensili sullo stato di ammissibilità dei casi, stabilendo protocolli come guida per il team.

Requisiti: 💡📊

  • Laurea in Odontoiatria, preferibilmente con specializzazione in Ortodonzia.
  • Background pluriennale nel trattamento su pazienti con allineatori invisibili e ortodonzia;
  • Know-How per l'utilizzo di scanner 3D e strumenti digitali (come ad esempio piattaforme dentali e principali software di Google Workspace).

Perché scegliere noi: 🙋 ♀️🙋 ♂️

  • Fai parte di team internazionale e multiculturale!
  • Stipendio competitivo con contratto a collaborazione in P.IVA;
  • Forti possibilità di carriera: con noi puoi crescere!
  • Ambiente di lavoro dinamico e collaborativo;
  • Sconti sull’acquisto di allineatori dentali e sbiancamento;
  • Cultura positiva, celebriamo i nostri risultati!

Cogli l'opportunità di avere un esperienza di start-up con noi. Siamo inoltre stati nominati da Linkedin l'azienda sanitaria con la crescita più rapida in Europa!

In Impress coltiviamo una cultura di inclusione e diversitá. L'opinione di ognuno per noi conta molto. I nostri criteri di selezione del personale sono applicati in maniera indiscriminatoria per eliminare le barriere di differenze per razza, colore, religione, origine, orientamento sessuale, genere, etá, disabilitá e qualsiasi altro aspetto.

Le nostre differenze producono efficacia ed efficienza nei nostri risultati...risultati condotti da decisioni migliori determinate da punti di vista innovativi influenzati proprio dalle differenziazioni.

Cobertura de 08:00 a 20:00 mediante turnos de 8.5hs
