Title: Lead Analytics Specialist
HTML:
Join Us

At Vodafone, we’re not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we’re shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.

Cyber Defence Operations (CDO) is Vodafone Group’s Cyber Defence Centre of Excellence, accountable for protecting Vodafone, its customers and its services against global cyber risk.

The Analytics Specialist is responsible for developing cross-Cyber Defence analytics and insight products that provide a holistic, asset-centric view of Vodafone’s security, operational and risk posture.

The role works across CTU, CSOC, CDIR and Security Testing & Exposure Management to aggregate, model and interpret data from multiple platforms, helping identify systemic patterns, control weaknesses, operational trends and emerging risks.

The role translates complex technical and operational data into trusted, reusable analytics that support incident response, threat-led defence, vulnerability prioritisation, exposure reduction, control improvement and leadership decision-making.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and own cross-Cyber Defence analytics use cases that provide trend-based and asset-centric insight across threat, monitoring, incident response, vulnerability and exposure management domains;
  • Design and maintain end-to-end analytics pipelines, from data sourcing and modelling through to dashboards, insights and executive-ready outputs;
  • Aggregate and normalise data from multiple platforms including Elastic data lakes, Dynatrace, Power BI, cloud platforms and cyber security tooling, ensuring consistency, quality and reusability;
  • Develop asset-centric views that correlate telemetry across infrastructure, applications, services, incidents, vulnerabilities and security controls to support a joined-up understanding of risk and performance;
  • Produce long-term trend analysis, behavioural baselining and forecasting to identify emerging risks, control degradation, systemic issues and opportunities for improvement;
  • Build and maintain dashboards and analytical products that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insight for technical and non-technical stakeholders;
  • Work across CTU, CSOC, Incident Management, STEM, and wider Technology, Network and Platform teams to shape analytics requirements, define success measures and ensure outputs align to real operational and strategic questions
  • Apply analytical and statistical techniques such as time-series analysis, clustering and regression to extract meaning from large, high-volume datasets;
  • Ensure analytics outputs are explainable, repeatable and trusted, with clear documentation, assumptions and data lineage;
  • Contribute analytical insight to strategic planning, operational reviews, risk discussions, investment decisions and control improvement initiatives across Vodafone;
  • Support the evolution of Cyber Defence analytics capabilities, including improved data models, shared metrics, and more effective use of security, operational and exposure data;
  • Contribute to cyber reporting, dashboards and briefings, ensuring accurate, timely and data-driven insights are shared with the right stakeholders


Who You Are

  • Demonstrable experience (typically 3–5 years) in data analytics, business intelligence, data science or a related analytical role;
  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience;
  • Working towards, or willingness to obtain, relevant certifications such as Power BI Data Analyst, Azure Data Fundamentals, or data analytics / data science certifications is desirable;
  • Strong experience in data analytics, business intelligence or data science, ideally within a cyber, technology or risk environment;
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate broad operational questions into scalable data models, metrics and visualisations;
  • Experience working with enterprise analytics and observability platforms such as Power BI, Elastic, Dynatrace, Splunk or similar;
  • Proven ability to work across large and complex datasets to identify trends, correlations, anomalies and emerging risks;
  • Comfortable engaging with stakeholders across cyber security, technology and leadership to understand problems and frame useful analytical questions;
  • Able to communicate insights clearly through visuals, storytelling and written narrative, tailored to different audiences;
  • Advanced capability in Power BI, including data modelling, DAX, visualisation and dashboard design;
  • Working knowledge of SQL and/or KQL for querying large-scale analytical datasets;
  • Experience using Python or similar languages for data preparation, analysis and statistical modelling is desirable;
  • Understanding of time-series analysis, trend analysis, statistical baselining and forecasting techniques;
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, data quality management and schema harmonisation across multiple data sources;
  • Practical understanding of cyber risk concepts across security monitoring, incident response, threat intelligence, vulnerability management and exposure management;
  • Ability to balance analytical rigour with pragmatism, delivering outputs that are useful, trusted and timely;
  • Experience integrating diverse data sources such as cloud platforms, endpoint telemetry, network/security tooling, threat intelligence feeds, vulnerability data and external exposure data;
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and support both operational and leadership decision-making;
  • Fluency in English


Not a perfect fit?

Worried that you don’t meet all the desired criteria exactly? At Vodafone we are passionate about empowering people and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity.

What's In It For You

  • Hybrid Work Model - Flexible hybrid work model with 8-10 in-office days per month, managed by team leaders;
  • Vodafone Products and Services - Employees get a mobile phone, free communication plan, data card, and various discounts on services and products;
  • Recognition - Recognition programs for innovative, creative, high-potential employees and exemplary behaviors;
  • Health and Well-being - Well-being Program offers nutrition and psychological consultations, webinars, workshops, and discounts on various services and products;
  • Learning - Access to Communities of Practice and a customizable digital training platform with high-quality content (namely Harvard Business Publishing, Skillsoft and Speexx);
  • Local and International Mobility - Internal recruitment with local and international rotation opportunities across departments and roles


Who We Are

We are a leading international Telco, serving millions of customers. At Vodafone, we believe that connectivity is a force for good. If we use it for the things that really matter, it can improve people's lives and the world around us. Through our technology we empower people, connecting everyone regardless of who they are or where they live and we protect the planet, whilst helping our customers do the same.

Belonging at Vodafone isn't a concept; it's lived, breathed, and cultivated through everything we do. You'll be part of a global and diverse community, with many different minds, abilities, backgrounds and cultures. We're committed to increase diversity, ensure equal representation, and make Vodafone a place everyone feels safe, valued and included.

If you require any reasonable adjustments or have an accessibility request as part of your recruitment journey, for example, extended time or breaks in between online assessments, please refer to https://careers.vodafone.com/application-adjustments/ for guidance.

Together we can.

Title: Wealth Management Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About The Job


We are seeking sharp and intellectually curious Senior Data Analyst to join our Wealth Management division. In this role, you will transform complex financial datasets into clear, actionable intelligence that empowers portfolio managers, relationship bankers and senior leadership to make better decisions for clients across the globe. You will be the core of data strategy – building scalable pipelines on Dataiku, crafting executive-grade dashboards in Power BI, and collaborating with various stakeholders to interpret the story behind the numbers


Your Main Activities Are


Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end data workflows using Dataiku, covering data ingestion, transformation, and model deployment across wealth portfolios
Build and own a suite of Power BI dashboards and reports that deliver real-time Assets Under Management (AUM), performance, and risk insights to senior stakeholders
Collaborate with relationship managers and investment advisors to translate business questions into analytical frameworks and measurable Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Ensure data quality, governance and compliance standards are upheld across all wealth data assets
Champion a data driven culture by mentoring junior data analysts and contributing to best practices documentation and internal training
Support regulatory and audit reporting requirements by maintaining traceable, well documented pipelines and data lineage records
Contribute to the continuous improvement of our analytics infrastructure, evaluating emerging tools and proposing enhancements aligned with business strategy at Wealth Management head office level


Profile And Skills To Success


Bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, Information Technology, Statistics, Mathematics or a related discipline
Minimum of 5 years’ experience in data analytics, preferably within the banking or financial services sector
Proficiency in Data visualization tools (Power BI or Tableau), Data Modelling
Proficiency in Dataiku or Alteryx or SAS or Domino or programming in Python, SQL, among others
Fluency in English
Adaptability, autonomy, proactivity, organized with the ability to multi-tasks
Result-driven, constantly looking for ways to improve your performance
Ability to collaborate/Teamwork in a collaborative / transversal way
Ability to share and to communicate with different stakeholders (Information Technology (IT)/Non-IT)


About The Team


As a leading global private bank, BNP Paribas Wealth Management delivers a tailor-made experience, with outstanding attention to detail along with precise, local knowledge backed by the global know-how of a worldwide banking group.  With a strong presence of almost 7.000 employees working in Europe, Asia and the Middle East and €462 billion assets under management as of December 2024, BNP Paribas Wealth Management (WM) is a global leader of the Private Banking industry
Since 2015, BNP Paribas Wealth Management has a competence center in Lisbon (Portugal International Markets Hub (PIMH)) to manage activities for several locations (Switzerland, Luxembourg, Germany, Monaco)
You will be attached to the Analytics team based in Portugal, you will report to your Head of Data Management and Business Analytics
The Wealth Management Head Office Data Office's mission is to manage all topics related to Data Governance and Strategy for Wealth Management including Data Management and Protection and Data Analytics


Why joining BNP Paribas?

BNP Paribas, The European Leader In Banking And Financial Services In Europe, Operates In 64 Countries And Has Nearly 180,000 Employees. The Group Is Structured Around Three Operating Divisions. Its Business Lines Cooperate Closely, As Part Of Our Integrated Model, To Meet The Needs Of All Our Clients In a Coordinated Manner


Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB), connects corporate clients needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities;
Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS), brings together all the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses;
Investment & Protection Services (IPS), combines a unique continuum of products and services across protection, saving, investment and real-estate.


Our presence in Portugal

In Portugal since 1985, BNP Paribas today has more than 9.700 employees, distributed across the Group's 10 business entities established in the country. Its presence also extends to 11 excellence centers providing value-added services to various countries where the BNP Paribas Group also operates.

Diversity and Inclusion Commitment

BNP Paribas´ Ambition Is To Cultivate An Open And Responsive Environment For All That Encourages Collaboration And Interaction. We Demonstrate Our Commitment By Actively Contributing To The Group’s Diversity And Inclusion Strategy And Goals, In Line With The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. As Part Of Our Local Corporate And Social Responsibility - Diversity & Inclusion Strategy, BNP Paribas Portugal Is Committed To


Promote a fair and unbiased recruitment process and offer professional development opportunities to all employees;
Celebrate diversity and advocate for inclusion, both externally and internally, encouraging employee’s participation, creating space for different voices to be heard.


To foster the effort of BNP Paribas Portugal, multiple initiatives and events take place throughout the year where our people can find out more on the importance of diversity inclusion at the workplace and in our society.

Remote Working Conditions

At BNP Paribas, we embrace a Smart Working framework based on trust, autonomy and collaboration. Within this framework, eligible employees can benefit from flexible remote working options adapted to our hybrid working environment. To ensure a comfortable and efficient working setup, eligible employees are provided with both office and home equipment, are entitled to an equipment allowance and can benefit from exclusive partnerships to purchase additional items at reduced prices.

Job Description


Design & Deploy: Create machine learning models and tailored AI solutions.
Innovate: Fine-tune and extend Large Language Models (LLMs) including open-source and commercial models.
Optimize: Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques for enhanced model efficiency.

Apply Traditional ML: Utilize decision trees, SVMs, neural networks, and more to solve diverse problems.

Document & Share: Maintain technical documentation for knowledge sharing and reproducibility.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
3+ years of hands-on experience in machine learning and AI development.
Strong expertise in Generative AI (model training, fine-tuning, and deployment).
Experience with open-source and commercial LLMs.
Proficiency in implementing RAG techniques.
Experience with vector databases.
Advanced programming skills in Python with frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Hugging Face.
Deep understanding of NLP techniques and architectures.
Practical experience with traditional AI/ML methods such as decision trees, SVMs, and neural networks. Practical experience with traditional AI/ML methods such as decision trees, SVMs, clustering and neural networks.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) for AI/ML deployments.

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Effective communication in public and teamwork skills.
Fluency in English (C1 level or higher) is mandatory.
Willingness to learn French.


Nice-to-Have Skills


Knowledge of reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF).
Familiarity with prompt engineering.
Understanding of ethical AI principles and model interpretability.
Fluency in French is a plus.

HTML:
Junte-se à NEWREST, multinacional de referência no catering aéreo, e contribua para a excelência dos nossos processos de Recursos Humanos e Payroll.

O Grupo NEWREST, presente em mais de 50 países, promove a inovação, a melhoria contínua e o desenvolvimento sustentável, colocando as pessoas no centro da sua atuação.

Pretendemos reforçar a nossa equipa em Lisboa com um(a) HR Data & Payroll Analyst, que alia a paixão pelos números à vontade de otimizar processos e apoiar a tomada de decisão.

Funções e Responsabilidades

  • Recolher, consolidar e analisar dados de payroll, assiduidade, recrutamento e gestão administrativa de RH, assegurando a qualidade e integridade da informação;
  • Desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e indicadores de desempenho de RH;
  • Automatizar processos de recolha, tratamento e disponibilização de dados, promovendo a eficiência e a digitalização dos processos;
  • Monitorizar tendências e desvios em custos de pessoal, absentismo, contratação e trabalho temporário, propondo ações de melhoria;
  • Prestar suporte analítico e funcional aos utilizadores dos sistemas de RH;
  • Recolher, validar e preparar os dados necessários ao processamento salarial;
  • Assegurar o processamento mensal de salários, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos e da legislação em vigor;
  • Efetuar o cálculo e a validação de remunerações, subsídios, descontos e demais incidências salariais;
  • Apoiar a elaboração e validação dos mapas e reportes de payroll e das respetivas obrigações legais e fiscais;
  • Preparar e submeter as declarações e reportes obrigatórios às entidades competentes;
  • Analisar e reconciliar desvios e inconsistências de payroll, propondo ações corretivas e melhorias de processo;
  • Prestar esclarecimentos aos colaboradores sobre matérias relacionadas com remunerações e processamento salarial;
  • Garantir a confidencialidade, consistência e fiabilidade dos dados e reportes de Recursos Humanos.
  • Licenciatura em Gestão, Recursos Humanos, Gestão, Economia ou área similar;
  • Experiência em payroll e análise de dados de recursos humanos (obrigatório);
  • Domínio avançado de Excel e de ferramentas de reporting e visualização de dados;
  • Conhecimentos de legislação laboral e fiscal aplicável ao payroll;
  • Bons conhecimentos de inglês;
  • Forte capacidade analítica, rigor, organização e orientação para a melhoria contínua.
  • Que Oferecemos
  • Integração num grupo multinacional sólido e em crescimento;
  • Projetos desafiantes e com impacto direto no negócio;
  • Formação contínua e oportunidades de desenvolvimento de carreira;
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, colaborativo e internacional.

Aceita o desafio?

Envie o seu CV para m.cardoso@newrest.eu e venha construir o futuro dos Recursos Humanos na Newrest Portugal.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
🚀 We’re hiring | Data Analyst 🚀




At Empa‑T, we believe that data is one of the most powerful drivers of business transformation. By transforming complex information into actionable insights, organizations can make smarter decisions, improve customer experiences, and optimize operational efficiency.




We are looking for a Data Analyst to join an international project within the Financial Services sector, helping business and operational teams leverage data, analytics, and automation to support strategic initiatives and drive continuous improvement.




Key Responsibilities

Collect, validate, process, and analyse data from multiple internal and external sources
Identify trends, patterns, and business opportunities through data-driven analysis
Support decision-making processes by providing actionable insights and recommendations
Design, develop, and maintain reports, dashboards, and visualizations for business stakeholders
Perform data preparation, blending, transformation, and automation using Alteryx
Contribute to the development and optimization of ETL processes and data pipelines
Support data warehousing and data industrialization initiatives
Collaborate closely with business teams, operations, sales, and stakeholders to understand data requirements
Improve operational processes and controls through analytics and automation
Present findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences
Contribute to innovative solutions involving AI, APIs, and data-driven products




Skills & Experience

+4 years of experience as a Data Analyst or similar role
Strong analytical, statistical, and problem-solving skills
Experience with Python
Experience with SQL
Experience with Alteryx is a plus
Experience with data visualization tools such as PowerBI or Tableau
Experience working with ETL processes and data warehousing concepts
Ability to manipulate, analyse, and interpret large datasets
Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into analytical solutions
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
Knowledge of PySpark, Airflow, Presto, Machine Learning, or AI-related initiatives is a plus
Fluency in English
French is a plus




📍 Location

Lisbon or Porto – Hybrid (3x/office)




Why Empa‑T?

At Empa‑T, we value empathy, integrity, and collaboration.

We work on impactful projects in innovative environments, where technology and people grow together. You'll have the opportunity to work with international teams, contribute to data-driven transformation initiatives, and continuously develop your skills while making a real impact on business outcomes.




🧡 Be part of a team where data, innovation, and technology transform the future of business.

Solid knowledge of:

Tableau
Power BI
Strong programming skills in Python, particularly using Pandas for data analysis.

Experience working with large, complex datasets and multi-source data environments.

Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate data into clear business insights.
Adaptability and ability to work in fast-paced, global environments.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and accuracy.
Results-driven mindset with strong delivery focus.
Problem-solving skills with the ability to design and improve analytical processes.
Proactive attitude and ability to work effectively within a team.
Strong collaboration skills across business and technical stakeholders.

English: Mastery level (mandatory).




Are you looking for an environment that values curiosity and commitment? Here, your contribution has real impact and individual growth is taken seriously.




Find with us the right opportunity to grow!

Long-term projects with national and international context (if applicable)
Opportunities to grow technically and professionally
A people-first culture, focused on transparency and trust
Teams that value ownership, collaboration and stability.

Thank you! :)

Inetum is a global leader in IT services, dedicated to providing innovative solutions to our clients. We are committed to fostering a dynamic, inclusive workplace that values diversity, where creativity and collaboration thrive. We operate in 19 countries with more than 28,000 employees worldwide.

Collaborate with team members across different locations to ensure smooth project execution.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously, demonstrating autonomy and strong time‑management skills.

3+ years of experience as data Analyst, developing Dashboard and DataViz
Knowledge of algorithms is a plus and will enable the candidate to be a force for proposing useful content related to cyber security risk management.
Expertise with POWERBI, TABLEAU, DATAIKU, PostgreSQL and ETL tools (e.g., TABLEAU Certified Data Analyst, DATAIKU Advanced Designer Certificate)
Basic Python skills
English B2+

Title: Reels Editor (Remote)
Description:
Most short-form editors are trapped in volume mills—churning out 50+ generic clips a day with zero creative input, and burning out in 3 months. We expect quality over mindless output, and actually want your creative ideas. If you’re an elite editor tired of being treated like a content factory, keep reading.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Edit short-form reels and podcast clips from raw creator content and interviews, identifying scroll-stopping moments that resonate with target audiences
Analyze trends in creator niches and propose fresh reel concepts tailored to each model's brand and personality
Ensure platform compliance (proper framing, audio, age-appropriate content)
Collaborate with creative team to refine edits based on feedback and achieve viral impact




REQUIREMENTS

Demonstrated short-form editing skill with a portfolio of approved, published Instagram/TikTok reels showing strong engagement and aesthetic quality (range and coachability weigh more than exact years)
Strong English (required) — the key language for communication and storytelling; we edit increasingly vlog-style content where English fluency directly shapes the edit. Spanish is a plus, not required.
Expert-level proficiency in CapCut — experience with DaVinci Resolve or Premiere Pro highly valued; must work on macOS (demonstrates commitment to professional-grade workflow and quality standards)
Can identify viral moments and execute polished, well-paced edits with strong hooks, clean captions, and purposeful text
Demonstrates creative ownership and aesthetic vision, plus openness to feedback and direction




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

30 days:

Daily output ramping toward ~20–25/day with 80%+ first-draft approval rate
Edits demonstrate understanding of brand voice and platform trends
Suggests 1+ format ideas per week

60 days:

Editing speed improves while maintaining quality standards
85%+ first-draft approval rate
Contributes 2+ trending format ideas per week

90 days:

90%+ first-draft approval rate (high proficiency across reel and podcast production)
Creates 1 original format used 5+ times by team across multiple creators
Demonstrates measurable creative impact on content performance




WHY BELLE MUSE?

A-players only—work with elite editors who give a shit about quality
Your creative ideas actually matter (we want originals, not just copies)
Clear performance metrics—no guessing if you’re doing well
Professional standards—macOS workflows, real training, no drama

Title: Auxiliar de Ação Médica (m/f) | Bloco Operatório
HTML:
Somos uma empresa 100% portuguesa, líder na prestação de cuidados de saúde de excelência em Portugal. Com 80 anos de história, a CUF surgiu com o propósito de cuidar das suas pessoas e famílias. Hoje, em constante crescimento, estamos ao serviço de todos os portugueses, que nos confiam a sua saúde e bem-estar.

Porquê a CUF?

Na CUF, acreditamos que cuidar dos nossos colaboradores é essencial para continuarmos a prestar cuidados de saúde de qualidade. Apostamos num ambiente inclusivo e cultura familiar entre as equipas que se reflete na forma de cuidar do nosso cliente.

Como vai fazer a diferença?

  • Proporciona os melhores cuidados de saúde aos nossos clientes;
  • Garante a higiene, conforto e segurança aos clientes internados e família;
  • Prepara salas e material de apoio necessário para as cirurgias;
  • Repõe stocks sempre que necessário;
  • Auxilia a equipa médica e de enfermagem;
  • Limpa e desinfeta materiais e áreas de trabalho.

O que precisa para ter sucesso nesta função?

  • 9º ano de escolaridade completo ou equivalente em Portugal (obrigatório);
  • Formação em saúde e/ou experiência em Bloco operatório (obrigatório);
  • Autorização de residência em Portugal, no caso de candidatos estrangeiros (obrigatório );
  • Disponibilidade para turnos rotativos - manhãs, tardes e noites (obrigatório).

Como é que nós cuidamos de si?

  • Contrato de trabalho direto com a CUF;
  • Integração numa empresa sólida, inovadora e em crescimento;
  • Formação inicial e contínua, através da Academia de Formação CUF;
  • Valorização das nossas pessoas através do crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Iniciativas de prevenção e bem-estar;
  • Entidade familiarmente responsável, reconhecendo a importância da conciliação entre a vida profissional, pessoal e familiar, com oferta de benefícios nesse sentido.

Na CUF estamos cientes do esforço e empenho das equipas e, por isso, apostamos na melhoria contínua do bem-estar e das condições para ter impacto na sua função.

Venha fazer parte de uma equipa que cuida de si, enquanto cuida dos outros!

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Join Axians, where innovation thrives on trust and autonomy, and where every challenge is an opportunity to create technology with impact.

Data Analyst

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a professional responsible for transforming data into actionable insights that support business decision-making within a financial markets environment. You will contribute to the development of data analysis, reporting, and visualization solutions, working across the entire data lifecycle, from data processing and warehousing to the delivery of dashboards and analytical tools. Your role will be key in enabling data-driven decisions through reliable, scalable, and high-quality data solutions.

What You Will Do On a Daily Basis


Collect, validate, and integrate data from multiple internal and external sources to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
Develop, maintain, and optimize ETL pipelines using Python and SQL.
Manage and enhance data warehouse structures to support business reporting and analytics needs.
Create and maintain interactive dashboards and reports in Tableau and Power BI for Front Office stakeholders.
Analyze large datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and business insights for Sales and Trading teams.
Collaborate closely with business sponsors, sales representatives, and traders to gather requirements and translate business needs into data solutions.
Monitor and improve data quality, data governance, and data processing performance.
Design and deliver automated reporting solutions to support decision-making processes.
Develop and maintain APIs and data services to facilitate data access and integration across platforms.
Contribute to the development of chatbot and analytical solutions that enhance user access to market intelligence and business insights.
Participate in the continuous improvement of data architecture, processes, and visualization standards.
Troubleshoot and resolve data-related issues across the data lifecycle, from ingestion to visualization.
Support the deployment of new analytics products and data solutions in an agile environment.
Document data processes, methodologies, and technical solutions to ensure knowledge sharing and maintainability.


Your Key Skills


Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to synthesize complex information and communicate insights effectively.
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.


Your Main Qualifications


Academic background in Engineering, Economics, Computing, Mathematics, Statistics, or related fields.
Professional experience (at least 2 years) in Tableau for data visualization.
Professional experience in data analysis with programming, preferably Python.
Ability to analyze, synthetize and simplify.
Knowledge of descriptive statistics and hypothesis testing is a plus.
Knowledge in Big Data technology such as Pyspark, Presto and Airflow is a plus.
Fluency in English (written & spoken).


What We Offer

Stable professional career

Working with Axians projects becomes an asset to those of us who want to offer stability through a secure career.

Prospects for career advancement

You can access training and new certifications that will further elevate your skills. The 360° evaluation from managers and peers will also allow you to evolve.

Work Life Balance

By collaborating with Axians, you will be able to reconcile work and family requirements without neglecting either area.

Attractive, Evolving Compensation

When working with Axians, you will have access to performance bonuses in addition to an attractive salary pack (base salary + benefits). You are also entitled to health insurance and an employee assistance program for you and your family (Psychological, Legal, Psychosocial, and Financial support).

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
In 1966, in Marseille, Pierre Bellon laid the foundations of what would become Sodexo, guided by a simple yet powerful idea: improving everyday life through services that truly matter.

Today, Sodexo is a global leader in Food and Services, supporting people at every moment of life, at work, in schools, hospitals and communities. With 426,000 colleagues across 43 countries, we serve 80 million consumers every day, generating €24.1 billion in revenues. Our growth goes hand in hand with social and environmental responsibility, driven by our purpose: to create a better everyday for everyone and build a better life for all.




About Sodexo Business Services (SBS)




Portugal is no exception! Eight years ago, we established Sodexo Business Services (SBS), our shared service center. Here, you will have the opportunity to join various Financial teams such as Record to Report, Order to Cash, Purchase to Pay, Financial Analysis, and Master Data, supporting European markets and ensuring business growth.




Join Us!

We are looking for talented professionals to be part of our team, bringing unique skills and perspectives to help us grow even further.




Data Analyst

The Data Analyst is responsible for the technical execution of reporting and insight that enhances transparency & business performance with particular emphasis on digitization (Power BI), process efficiency & solution




⚙What will you do?

Enhancing our digital reporting suite & ensuring smooth execution of business-critical activities.
Demonstrate strong technical capability across reporting tools,
Accountable for scoping, designing, and delivering reporting developments.
Explore new ways to leverage reporting technologies, with a focus on building advanced proficiency in tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, and Excel.
Ensure that reporting output and architecture is coherent and consistent with our governance framework and standards.
Evaluate reporting processes and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce non‑value‑adding analysis.
Engage proactively with stakeholders to deliver reporting and insights, building effective business partnerships and communicating data in a clear, relatable narrative.
Translate broad or unclear stakeholder requirements into structured reporting plans and deliverables.
Be able to shift between data modelling, content creation, commercial insight & business partnering.




🤙What You Need to Succeed:

Bachelor’s degree in relevant field
Fluency in English required, ability to speak other European language is a plus
Focus on produt excellence, integrity and costumer focus
Experiency in Power BI, Power Automate, and Excel.
Continuous improvement mindset
Communication skills
Problem solving
Be flexible and versatile




What we have to offer you?

Hybrid working model;
Flexible working hours;
Health & Life Insurance;
Meal allowance paid in Meal Card;
Additional Days off: extra vacation day, employee’s birthday, volunteering day;
Opportunity to grow professionally inside the Company;
Possibility to participate in multicultural projects;
Several internal activities aiming to promote our team´s wellbeing.




📩 Apply now! Send your CV to Recruitment.SBS.Portugal@sodexo.com with the job title in the subject line. Explore all our career opportunities here: Sodexo Careers.

Learn more about Sodexo: YouTube - Sodexo.




Diversity & Inclusion Statement

Sodexo is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit.




🔒 Data Privacy:

We respect your privacy. Your personal data will be used exclusively for recruitment purposes, processed under GDPR regulations, and treated confidentially. For further details, contact privacy.sbs@sodexo.com.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
We are growing. And we are looking for talented people.




At Decskill, we believe that technological excellence is driven by human talent.

We are an IT consulting company with more than 10 years of consolidated experience in the market, focused on building long-term relationships with both our clients and our people. Today, we are a community of over 800 professionals, working from Lisbon, Porto, and Madrid, contributing to impactful technology initiatives.




As part of the Astek Group, we combine a strong local culture with a global presence, being active in around 23 countries across 4 continents. This allows us to offer an international context, diverse challenges, and long-term career opportunities, while staying close to our teams.




We are looking for an Data Analyst!




Responsabilities:

Collect, process, and analyze large datasets to support the Global Markets Front Office.
Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL processes and automated data pipelines.
Build, optimize, and maintain data warehouses and data models to support business reporting and analytics.
Develop dashboards, reports, and data visualizations that provide actionable business insights.
Automate data processing and reporting workflows using Python and SQL.
Collaborate with business sponsors, Sales, Traders, and technical teams to understand data requirements and deliver analytical solutions.
Perform data validation, quality assurance, and reconciliation to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
Translate business requirements into technical data solutions and analytical models.
Support the industrialization and optimization of data processing activities.
Identify opportunities to improve data quality, reporting efficiency, and operational processes.
Document data flows, ETL processes, and analytical solutions following best practices.




Requirements:

Technical Skills

Experience in Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, or Data Engineering roles.
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data processing, automation, and analysis.
Experience designing and maintaining ETL processes and data pipelines.
Solid knowledge of Data Warehousing concepts, data modeling, and relational databases.
Experience building reports, dashboards, and data visualizations using BI tools.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.
Experience working with large and complex datasets.
Knowledge of data quality, data validation, and reporting best practices.
Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into technical data solutions.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working directly with business users and technical teams.
Good level of english.




Nice to Have

Experience within Global Markets, Capital Markets, Investment Banking, or Financial Services.
Knowledge of Front Office business processes and financial products.
Experience with data automation and process industrialization initiatives.
Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and modern analytics ecosystems.
Experience working in Agile environments.




Are you looking for an environment that values curiosity and commitment? Here, your contribution has real impact and individual growth is taken seriously.




Find with us the right opportunity to grow!




What you can expect from us:

Long-term projects with national and international context (if applicable)
Opportunities to grow technically and professionally
A people-first culture, focused on transparency and trust
Teams that value ownership, collaboration and stability.




If you’re interested in this job, please send your CV to cesaltina.abreu@decskill.com with reference “CA/DataAnalyst".




Thank You! 😊

Title: Data Analyst – Commercial (m/f/d)
HTML:
Chemical Industry | Data Analyst – Commercial



Your new Company


Our client is a Global Recognized Organization operating at the forefront of advanced materials and specialty solutions. With a strong international footprint and a workforce of around 1 000 professionals.


Driven by deep scientific expertise and a strong commitment to innovation, the Organization leverages advanced capabilities in material sciences, formulation technologies, and surface modification to deliver tailored solutions.


With a clear focus on innovation, operational excellence, and professional development, this is an opportunity to join a Company that combines global scale with a dynamic and forward-thinking mindset.



Your new Role


The Data Analyst – Commercial transforms complex Datasets into clear, actionable insights that support decision making across the organization. Working within a Matrix structure and closely aligned with the Commercial function, this person partners with business stakeholders to understand priorities, interpret commercial Data, and deliver high-quality analysis, reporting, dashboards, and presentations.


This person reports to the Business Data Manager, and will collaborate closely with Commercial stakeholders, Business Leaders, Technical Specialists, and Data Governance teams to support performance cycles, improve reporting capabilities, and strengthen data-driven decision making across the business.


The Data Analyst – Commercial will:

  • Partner with Commercial stakeholders to understand business priorities and deliver Data-driven insights that support operational and strategic decision-making;
  • Produce accurate and timely management reporting, analyzing commercial performance and identifying trends, risks, opportunities, and deviations from plan;
  • Support functional performance cycles (including sales pipeline reviews, demand planning, SKU rationalization activities, and sales forecasting);
  • Execute and support Data creation, updates, clean-up, archiving, and deletion activities related to customer Data, pricing, rebates, discounts, commissions, sales areas, and commercial taxonomies;
  • Ensure commercial Data is accurate and consistent across business systems, validating and preparing Datasets in line with Data governance standards;
  • Act as a subject matter expert in SalesForce, providing user support, training, guidance, and continuous improvement recommendations;
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards, reports, and visualizations to improve visibility of commercial performance and decision-making;
  • Prepare and deliver reports, presentations, and commercial insights for sales meetings, customer reviews, and other business reviews;
  • Prepare reports linking SalesForce and Sales Data and support updates of R&D/NBO pipeline information for internal and external communications;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve Data quality, analytical capabilities, reporting processes, and business tools;


A typical day will include analyzing commercial performance, maintaining dashboards, supporting sales and demand planning activities, attending sales meetings, validating Data quality, supporting SalesForce users, and delivering insights that support key business decisions.


Please consider that this role requires availability for occasional travel to other company sites, approximately once per year.



What you will need to succeed


As a Data Analyst – Commercial, you will need:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Systems, Data Management, or another analytical or business-related field;
  • +3 years of experience within an International Manufacturing or Industrial environment;
  • +3 years of experience in analytical or support roles within Sales, Commercial, or related business functions;
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, reports, and Data visualizations that deliver actionable business insights;
  • Experience supporting demand planning, sales performance reviews, pipeline analysis, customer Data management, pricing, and commercial reporting;
  • Advanced Data collection, cleansing, validation, and reporting skills;
  • Experience working within Matrix Organizations and collaborating with Cross-Functional Teams (would be a plus);
  • Advanced Excel skills (including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, advanced functions, and graphs);
  • Experience with project management tools;
  • Knowledge of Python, SQL, and SharePoint management (would be a plus);
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outputs in a fast-paced international environment;
  • Excellent communication skills – Fluency in English.


What the Company can offer you


Have the opportunity to join a cross-functional team in an international company with a multicultural working environment!



Next Steps


If you are interested in this opportunity, please send us your updated CV. If you are looking for another type of professional challenge, please contact us to discuss other career opportunities, always in complete confidence.

Title: Data Analyst - Finance (m/f/d)
HTML:
Chemical Industry | Data Analyst – Finance


Your new Company


Our client is a Global Recognized Organization operating at the forefront of advanced materials and specialty solutions. With a strong international footprint and a workforce of around 1 000 professionals.


Driven by deep scientific expertise and a strong commitment to innovation, the Organization leverages advanced capabilities in material sciences, formulation technologies, and surface modification to deliver tailored solutions.


With a clear focus on innovation, operational excellence, and professional development, this is an opportunity to join a Company that combines global scale with a dynamic and forward-thinking mindset.


Your new Role


The Data Analyst – Finance transforms complex Datasets into clear, actionable insights that support decision making across the organization. Working within a matrix structure and closely aligned with Finance, this person partners with business stakeholders to understand priorities, interpret financial and operational Data, and deliver high-quality analysis, reporting, dashboards, and presentations.


This person reports to the Business Data Manager, and will collaborate closely with the Finance, Business Leaders, Technical Specialists, and Data Governance teams to support planning cycles, improve reporting capabilities, and strengthen Data-driven decision making across the business.


The Data Analyst – Finance will:

  • Partner with Finance stakeholders to understand business priorities and deliver Data-driven insights that support operational and strategic decision-making;
  • Produce accurate and timely management reporting, analyzing financial performance, identifying variances, trends, risks, and opportunities against plans and forecasts;
  • Support planning, budgeting, forecasting, CAPEX submissions, and actuals-to-plan reconciliations, ensuring Data accuracy and consistency across business systems;
  • Manage provisions, accruals, and financial Data, ensuring information integrity, compliance with Data governance standards, and the reliability of ERP and reporting system outputs;
  • Act as a subject matter expert in key Finance areas (including cost accounting, CAPEX, pricing and margins, fixed costs, working capital, and operational finance);
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards, reports, and visualizations to improve business visibility, performance monitoring, and decision-making;
  • Promote self-service reporting capabilities through training, user support, and best-practice guidance on Power BI solutions and planning tools;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen analytical capabilities, optimize reporting processes, and improve Data foundations across the organization;
  • Support business projects, process improvements, and automation initiatives that drive efficiency, performance, and continuous improvement.


A typical day will include analyzing financial performance, maintaining dashboards, supporting planning and forecasting activities, collaborating with Finance and business stakeholders, validating Data quality, and delivering insights that support key business decisions.


Please consider that this role requires availability for occasional travel to other company sites.


What you will need to succeed

As a Data Analyst – Finance, you will need:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field;
  • Professional Accounting Qualification (would be a plus);
  • +3 years of experience within International Manufacturing, Industrial, or Global Business environments.
  • +3 years of experience in Financial Analysis, Finance Support, or other analytical Finance-related roles.
  • Proven experience supporting Business Stakeholders through Financial Analysis, Performance Monitoring, and Data-Driven Decision-Making;
  • Experience developing and maintaining Power BI Dashboards, Reports, and Data Visualizations for Business Performance and Management Reporting;
  • Experience working with ERP systems, large business Datasets, and Data Governance practices to ensure Data Integrity and Reporting Accuracy;
  • Experience working within Matrix Organizations and collaborating with Cross-Functional Teams would be advantageous;
  • Experience in Budgeting, Forecasting, Financial Planning, Variance Analysis, Accruals, Reconciliations, CAPEX, Cost Accounting, Pricing & Margins, Fixed Costs, Working Capital, and Operational Finance;
  • Advanced Excel skills (including Pivot Tables, Complex Data Analysis, and Financial Modelling);
  • Knowledge of Python and/or SQL (would be a plus);
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outputs in a fast-paced international environment;
  • Excellent communication skills – Fluency in English.


What the Company can offer you


Have the opportunity to join a cross-functional team in an international company with a multicultural working environment!


Next Steps


If you are interested in this opportunity, please send us your updated CV. If you are looking for another type of professional challenge, please contact us to discuss other career opportunities, always in complete confidence.

Title: Business Data Analyst (Maintenance)
Description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Purpose



As a Business Data Analyst, you analyze and interpret complex data to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development. Work closely with stakeholders to identify data needs, create reports, and develop data models that drive business performance and optimize operational efficiency. Ensure data accuracy and contribute to the continuous improvement of data processes and tools.



Responsibilities



Analyze and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business needs and data requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
Develop and maintain data models, dashboards, and reports, providing clear and concise visualizations that communicate key findings to stakeholders.
Ensure data accuracy and integrity by performing data validation, cleansing, and quality checks, maintaining high standards of data governance.
Extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into analytical tools, ensuring data is prepared and structured for analysis.
Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies within data sets, providing insights that drive business process improvements and operational efficiency.
Support the development and implementation of data-driven strategies, working closely with business units to optimize performance and achieve key objectives.
Present findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders, translating complex data insights into understandable and actionable business terms.
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in data analytics, integrating new tools and methodologies to enhance analytical capabilities.
Provide training and support to team members and other departments on data analysis techniques and the use of analytical tools, fostering a data-driven culture within the organization.



Education



Bachelor's degree in data science, business analytics, computer science, statistics, or a related field is required. Certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are highly recommended. Proficiency in data analysis, statistical tools, and business intelligence (BI) platforms is essential. A master’s degree in a related field is preferred but not mandatory.



Experience



Minimum of 5 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field, with demonstrated expertise in analyzing business data to support decision-making processes.
Proven experience in collecting, cleaning, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that drive business performance.
Strong technical background with hands-on experience in using data analysis tools and languages such as SQL, Python, R, or Excel, and proficiency in business intelligence platforms like Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement data models, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders across the organization.
Experience in working closely with business units to understand their data needs, translating business requirements into data-driven solutions that support strategic goals.
Proficiency in data visualization techniques, with the ability to present complex data in a clear and compelling manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality management, and best practices for ensuring data integrity and accuracy across systems.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify data-related issues and recommend effective solutions to improve business processes.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including IT, finance, and operations, to support data-driven initiatives.
Relevant certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are preferred.



Functional Competencies

Compliance

Governance, Risk and Control

Analytics and reporting

IT Tools and application

Cost and budget control

Business Partnering

Digital savvy

Business Acumen

Contract Management

Management of change application

GENERAL INFORMATION

SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group (“the Company”). For further information, please visit our website at www.sbmoffshore.com. The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

Title: Data Quality Analyst (AI Model Data Analyst)
Description:
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Location: Portugal (1-2 days in office per week)

Travel: Occasional international travel may be required.

Salary: €16,000–€20,000 per annum

Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick-and-mortar retail using deep-learning computer vision. Focal has been deployed at scale with the top retailers in the world. We are looking for smart, creative, and passionate people who love to learn, enjoy thinking critically, share our values, and want to build a great and enduring company.

We have built the next-generation operating system for brick & mortar retail. This OS leverages shelf-mounted cameras that constantly measure the state of the retailers’ shelves and use that information to order quicker and smarter, planogram better, and schedule, direct, train, and manage their staff. We have proven this with major retailers around the world.

Job Description

The quality of our computer-vision models depends entirely on the quality of the data they learn from. We are seeking a dedicated Data Quality Analyst to clean, review, and curate the training data that powers our systems. In this role you will assume accountability for the accuracy and consistency of our datasets, directly improving how well our models detect products. Meticulous attention to detail, strong data-handling skills, and the ability to meet quality and speed Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are essential.

What You Will Be Doing


Review, clean, and correct labelled image and product data used to train our computer-vision models.
Identify and fix mislabelled, inconsistent, or low-quality data, and flag systematic errors in the labelling pipeline.
Conduct routine quality-assurance checks to catch data issues before they reach model training.
Onboard and scan products into the system, ensuring catalogue and reference data are accurate and complete.
Compare model predictions against ground truth to surface edge cases and areas where the model underperforms.
Work collaboratively with the machine-learning and operations teams to improve labelling guidelines and data standards.
Meet or exceed speed and quality Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) consistently.
Communicate effectively with supervisors and team members, providing updates on progress and raising any issues or challenges encountered.


Requirements:


Strong attention to detail and a genuine care for data accuracy and consistency.
Comfort working with large volumes of data, spreadsheets, and data-review or annotation tools
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to spot patterns and root-cause data errors.
An interest in or exposure to machine learning, computer vision, or AI data pipelines is advantageous but not essential.
Time Management: ability to work well under pressure, meet deadlines, and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
Communication Skills: effective communication to liaise with supervisors, team members, and the ML team, providing updates and raising issues.
Ability to work independently and stay focused on repetitive, detail-heavy tasks for extended periods.


Why Focal Systems


Strong Values and Mission — We are a tightly-knit team with an ambitious mission and a strong set of core values, which define our approach to business and have successfully guided us since inception.
Exceptional Team — We are a team of hard-working, fun-loving professionals from some of the most eminent universities, research labs, and tech companies of our time. We pride ourselves on recruiting exceptional individuals to help us redefine the state-of-the-art.
Outstanding Partners — We work with 10+ of the largest retailers in the world and have a world-class roster of investors, advisors and partners to support & advise us in our endeavors.


What we offer

We care deeply about the health, happiness, and wellbeing of all of our employees. We offer:


Paid Time Off
Pension
Sick Leave

Opportunity to accelerate the pace of digitalization through advanced technology, business intelligence, and analytics.
Driving high-impact insights enhancing decision making across the entire organization.
Interaction with senior business leaders on regular basis to drive their business towards impactful change.

Translate business problems into analytical solutions, from requirement gathering to model deployment and monitoring.
Build, deploy, and maintain machine learning models (e.g. Churn, CLV, Segmentation, Personalization) using modern MLOps frameworks (e.g. MLflow, Git).
Leverage Databricks, Azure, or similar cloud infrastructure for scalable data processing and model deployment.
Use Python, PySpark, and common ML libraries (e.g. scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, etc.) for data transformation, model development, and evaluation.

Communicate findings and recommendations clearly through compelling storytelling and visualizations.

0–3 years of experience in data science or advanced analytics.

Proven ability to manage the full lifecycle of an ML solution; business understanding, data wrangling, and modelling, to production deployment and monitoring.
Hands-on experience with MLflow, Git, and MLOps frameworks.
Solid programming skills in Python, including libraries like pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, matplotlib, seaborn, and PySpark.
Experience with Azure (preferred) or AWS, especially in the context of Databricks, data pipelines, and model hosting.
Good understanding of data warehousing and querying using SQL.
Familiarity with statistical concepts (e.g. experiment design, hypothesis testing, p-values).
Experience or strong interest in Generative AI applications, such as LLM-based solutions, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or AI-assisted analytics is a plus.
Exposure to Reinforcement Learning concepts is a plus, especially in areas like decision optimization, personalization, or next-best-action use cases.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to present technical insights to non-technical audiences.
Fluency in English (written and spoken).
Experience within the retail and fashion industry (nice to have).
Experience within international environments, consultancies, or a start-up environment (nice to have).

Title: Data Analyst Finance
Description:
Job Summary

The Data Analyst - Finance transforms complex datasets into clear, actionable insights that support decision making across the organisation. Working as part of a matrix team and aligned to Finance, the role partners closely with business stakeholders to understand their priorities, interpret data in context, and deliver high quality analysis, dashboards, reporting, and presentations. The role is responsible for interpreting financial results, supporting planning and forecasting cycles.The Data Analyst - Finance also supports Finance with projects, tools, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance performance, drive productivity and strengthen data driven decision making with involvement in and coordination of the optimization of functional processes, tools, and systems.

Responsibilities

Job Description


Functional Business Partnering and Insight Generation
You partner with the supported function to understand business priorities, interpret analytical results, and translate data into meaningful insights.
You produce accurate, timely monthly management information for the area supported, including analysis, interpretation, and presentation of financial results. In particular, you monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) specific to the function supported and highlight emerging issues or deviations from plan.
You support functional performance cycles such as planning, forecasting, budgeting, capex submissions.
You review financial plans and budgets, monitor progress, highlight variances, and ensure business leaders remain informed of financial performance and emerging issues.
You provide clear and actionable analysis on trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities relevant to the supported function to support operational and strategic decision-making.
You support the preparation of internal and external presentations, ensuring insights are communicated clearly and effectively.
You act as a trusted analytical advisor within a matrix structure, ensuring strong communication and alignment with both functional leaders and the Business Data Manager.
Financial Systems, Controls & Reconciliations
You ensure all plans, forecasts, capex submissions, and relevant projects are accurately captured in the appropriate systems.
You liaise with Finance and Business leaders to confirm projects remain within approved delegations.
You own actuals‑to‑Plan‑to‑Forecast reconciliations for the supported area.
You are responsible for the provisions & accruals relevant to the business area supported.
Data Cleaning, Preparation, Validation & Governance Alignment
You ensure that data is clean and accurate for your function across various sources, such as JDE/ERP and other financial systems.
You conduct cleaning, validation and preparation of data for operational use and analysis, ensuring accuracy and consistency in line with data governance standards and business guidelines.
You validate the finance dashboards used by colleagues in the Finance team are accurate and without errors. When an issue is identified, you deep-dive into the matter and propose a resolution to the Data Manager and respective Finance stakeholder.
You identify other data quality issues and escalate them appropriately to the Business Data Manager and Data Architecture and Governance team.
You ensure all reporting uses approved definitions, metrics, and governed datasets.
Subject-Matter Expertise, Dashboards & Visualisation
You act as a subject matter expert in a designated field (e.g., e.g., functional fixed costs, operations and cost accounting, standard costing, capex, pricing and margin analysis, property and lease costs, or working capital).
You maintain PowerBI dashboards, reports, and visualisations that enable stakeholders to easily interpret key metrics and trends.
You run and distribute reports when required and not available in self-serve mode (e.g., performance reviews, monthly business updates), while promoting self‑service where appropriate.
You continuously improve tools and dashboard performance, usability, and clarity.
You suggest and participate in developing improvements to dashboards and reports
Collaboration, Capability Build and Continuous Improvement
You provide super‑user type support and training to stakeholders on designed tools (e.g Anaplan, Capex tool), Power BI and data‑related activities.
You promote a data-driven culture across Elementis.
Consolidate feedback on new or updated reporting requirements and support the development of these tools and new Power BI dashboards or enhancements.
Collaborate with the Business Data Manager, Technical Specialist, and Data Governance teams to improve data foundations, reporting processes, and analytical capabilities.
Participate in periodic rotation across these areas to broaden capability and organisational resilience.
Functional Projects & Initiatives
Support functional projects and initiatives by providing analytical input, co-ordination capabilities, and subject-matter expertise that enable better decision‑making, higher growth or more efficient operations.
Contribute to process improvements, automation opportunities, and enhancements to functional performance tools.
Coordinate with cross‑functional teams to ensure project deliverables are aligned, well‑structured, and supported by accurate data.


Decision making

You recommend accruals and provisions for the business unit supported.

You validate business requests relating to data changes before instructing DIG to implement changes ensuring that both functional guidelines and data governance and quality guidelines are met.

You decide how to structure analysis and visualisations to meet business needs.

You resolve day‑to‑day analytical issues to ensure insights are accurate, timely, and aligned with functional expectations.

What will it take

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Internship Programme

Our Internship Programme is designed for ambitious students who want to make their summer count. Over 8–10 paid weeks, you’ll work on real projects, tackle meaningful challenges, and develop your skills alongside industry experts. It’s an opportunity to learn, innovate, and build a solid foundation for your career.

Top performers may be offered a place on our Graduate Programme the following year, giving you the opportunity to return and continue your journey at Revolut.

Our Data Science team solves complex problems with smart, practical solutions. Data Scientists and Analysts work directly with product teams to uncover insights, guide decisions, and improve how customers experience Revolut. They do this by delivering scalable solutions that move the business forward.

We’re looking for Data Scientist and Analyst Interns who believe no data task is too complex. You’ll dig into databases, uncover root causes, design smart solutions, and write the code to bring them to life.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

Join us from anywhere

The Internship Programme is open to international applicants ready to relocate to one of our tech hubs in Poland, Portugal, the UAE, or the UK. Key dates


Applications: open from May 2026
Recruitment process: July–December 2026
Programme start: June / July 2027


Roles are filled on a rolling basis — apply early.

Taking part in a hands-on bootcamp and working on real projects across multiple teams
Helping to build analytical tools and machine learning models (such as dashboards and ETLs) to support product launches
Improving visibility in user sign-up flows and operational funnels
Enhancing and maintaining data infrastructure (including ETLs and LookML) to keep data accessible and reliable
Collaborating with teams across Operations, Growth, and Product to refine features and uncover insights
Supporting decision-making with ad-hoc analysis (e.g., interest rate sensitivity, incentive profitability, conversion rates)
Learning from industry leaders and staying aligned with team priorities through weekly meetings
Managing tasks, tracking progress, and communicating key outcomes
Sharing updates with our global teams
Receiving regular feedback to guide your development


What You'll Need


To be in your penultimate year of a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, maths, physics, or a similar field (graduating in 2028)
Impressive Python and SQL skills
An interest or experience in analytics engineering, product analytics, data science, or ML engineering
A solid foundation in maths and statistics
A proactive, results-driven mindset
Fluency in English
Great communication, organisational, and problem-solving skills
To be comfortable working in a fast-paced, diverse team environment
Full-time availability for summer 2027
The ability to attend a Revolut office in your country of employment at least 3 days per week (this is a hybrid role)

That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Company Description

Natixis in Portugal is a Centre of Expertise whose mission is to transform traditional banking by developing innovative solutions for the business, operations and work culture of Groupe BPCE worldwide.

As part of Groupe BPCE’s international division, Natixis in Portugal designs and delivers solutions for its two core areas — Corporate & Investment Banking and Asset & Wealth Management — as well as transversal services that support all entities across the Group.

With more than 3,000 employees representing 46 nationalities, the teams work across Information Technology, Banking Support Activities, and Compliance, in an integrated, inclusive, and cross-functional way, supporting all business lines and platforms of the Group.

A disruptive mindset and a culture of proximity and agility identify Natixis in Portugal Team and reflect the company's mission to transform traditional banking at a global scale: a perfect match in the Portuguese dynamics and entrepreneurial ecosystem.

Job Description

Within the IT department of Natixis BPCESI (BPCE Solutions Informatiques), in Distribution et Data: We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst to join our team. A strong background in data analysis, statistical methods, and data visualization is required. Work closely with various departments to gather data, analyze trends, and provide actionable insights to support business objectives.

Main Responsibilities


Gather and clean data from various sources, including databases, spreadsheets, and external APIs; maintain and update databases to ensure data integrity and accessibility.
Analyze large datasets to identify patterns, trends, and correlations, using statistical techniques to interpret data and generate actionable insights.
Create comprehensive reports and dashboards to present findings to stakeholders and prepare visualizations using tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Excel.
Work closely with cross-functional teams, including marketing, finance, and operations, to understand their data needs and provide support.
Collaborate with data engineers and IT staff to improve data collection and processing methods.
Provide recommendations based on data analysis to drive business strategies and improve performance; monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and report on progress.
Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in data analysis and visualization; identify opportunities for process improvements and implement solutions.


Qualifications

Hard Skills:


Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
Proven experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar role.
Proficiency in data analysis tools such as SQL,
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI).
Familiarity with statistical methods and data modeling techniques is a plus.
Must be french-speaker, at least C1.


Soft Skills


Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data concepts to non-technical stakeholders.


We will only consider CVs in English.

Additional Information

Our workplace reflects the vibrant spirit of our locations, with initiatives such as a Green Transportation Budget, electric bikes and a flexible Hybrid Work Policy. We promote wellbeing through the Honolulu Wellness Club, a Prayer Room, a Lactation Room, and themed Villages that inspire creativity and collaboration. Through our ESG and DEI strategies, we are commited to being inclusive, caring, and fair, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
